<!--
Run order (see README.md): the Python steps in scripts/ (01a-02e) download and aggregate the raw data
to monthly fields; this single R Markdown file then carries out ALL statistical analysis, tables and maps.
Render with:  Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('Potohar_Drought_Analysis.Rmd')"
Heavy intermediate results are cached as .rds in cache_R/ (delete a file to recompute that step).
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE, fig.align = "center",
                      dpi = 110, out.width = "100%")
t_start <- Sys.time()
# v2.2 Item 6: every warning is logged (chunk label + message) to logs/warnings.log instead of being suppressed
dir.create("logs", showWarnings = FALSE); WLOG <- file.path(normalizePath("logs"), "warnings.log"); cat("", file = WLOG)   # resolved at run time (parallel workers)
knitr::knit_hooks$set(warning = function(x, options) { cat(paste0("[", options$label, "] ", gsub("\n", " ", x), "\n"), file = WLOG, append = TRUE); x })
MASTER_PID <- Sys.getpid(); invisible(file.remove(list.files("logs", pattern = "^warnings\\.log\\.[0-9]+$", full.names = TRUE)))
# parallel workers write to their own file (logs/warnings.log.<pid>), merged into warnings.log in the export chunk, so lines never interleave
logw <- function(expr, where) withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) { lf <- if (Sys.getpid() == MASTER_PID) WLOG else paste0(WLOG, ".", Sys.getpid())
  cat(paste0("[", where, "] ", conditionMessage(w), "\n"), file = lf, append = TRUE); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })

# ---------- caching helper: evaluates expr only if the .rds does not exist ----------
cached <- function(name, expr) {
  f <- file.path(CACHE, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(readRDS(f))
  x <- expr; saveRDS(x, f); x
}
logp <- function(...) cat(format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), ..., "\n", file = file.path(ROOT, "logs", "rmd_run.log"), append = TRUE)

# ---------- IEEE figure style (Times, 8 pt, colour-blind-safe palettes) ----------

theme_ieee <- function(base = 8) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey88"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3),
          strip.text = element_text(size = base, face = "bold", margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = base),
          legend.text = element_text(size = base - 1), axis.title = element_text(size = base),
          axis.text = element_text(size = base - 1, colour = "grey15"), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 2),
          panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey30"))
}

  ggsave(file.path(FIG, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
  invisible(p)
}

# ---------- IEEE tables (CSV + DOCX) ----------
roman <- function(i) as.character(utils::as.roman(i))
save_table <- function(dt, n, title, name, note = NULL, digits = 2) {
  dt <- as.data.table(dt)
  fwrite(dt, file.path(TAB, paste0(name, ".csv")))
  num <- names(dt)[sapply(dt, is.numeric)]
  ft <- flextable(dt) |> colformat_double(j = num, digits = digits) |>
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |> fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
    bold(part = "header") |> align(align = "center", part = "header") |> align(j = num, align = "center", part = "body") |>
    border_remove() |> hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "header") |>
    hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 0.5), part = "header") |> hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 1), part = "body") |>
    set_caption(caption = paste0("TABLE ", if (is.character(n)) n else roman(n), "\n", toupper(title))) |> autofit()
  if (!is.null(note)) ft <- add_footer_lines(ft, note) |> fontsize(size = 7, part = "footer") |> font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "footer")
  doc <- read_docx() |> body_add_flextable(ft)
  print(doc, target = file.path(TAB, paste0(name, ".docx")))
  ft
}
```

# Study area and data (Methodology II)

## Boundaries, Soan basin and analysis grid (II-A)

The four districts and Islamabad Capital Territory (OCHA COD-AB 2022) were taken as the study area. The Soan basin was delineated (D8, Copernicus DEM; `scripts/01d_boundaries_basin.py`) to Dhok Pathan and Chirah, and to the Indus confluence at Makhad.
All gridded analyses use the native **0.25° NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 grid**, the finest scale common to the projections and the observations. Observed maps are also produced at **0.05°** (CHIRPS native resolution).

```{r study-area}
B <- file.path(ROOT, "01_boundaries")
dist   <- st_read(file.path(B, "potohar_districts.gpkg"), layer = "districts", quiet = TRUE)
region <- st_read(file.path(B, "potohar_districts.gpkg"), layer = "union", quiet = TRUE)
nbrs   <- st_read(file.path(B, "potohar_districts.gpkg"), layer = "neighbours", quiet = TRUE)
basins <- st_read(file.path(B, "soan_basins.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)
basin  <- basins[grepl("Dhok Pathan, GLO-90", basins$name), ]
rivers <- st_read(file.path(B, "soan_rivers.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)
pak0   <- st_read(file.path(dirname(cfg$paths$boundaries), "pak_admin0.shp"), quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(4326)
pak1   <- st_read(file.path(dirname(cfg$paths$boundaries), "pak_admin1.shp"), quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(4326)
dem90  <- rast(file.path(B, "dem_glo90_potohar.tif"))
basin_tab <- fread(file.path(B, "basin_areas.csv"))

# ---- 0.25 deg analysis grid and area weights ----
res <- cfg$domain$grid_res; bb <- unlist(cfg$domain$download_bbox)
glon <- round(seq(bb[1] + res / 2, bb[2], by = res), 3); glat <- round(seq(bb[3] + res / 2, bb[4], by = res), 3)
make_grid <- function(lons, lats, r) {
  g <- CJ(lat = lats, lon = lons)
  g[, ilon := match(lon, lons)][, ilat := match(lat, lats)]
  polys <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) st_polygon(list(matrix(c(
    g$lon[i] - r / 2, g$lat[i] - r / 2, g$lon[i] + r / 2, g$lat[i] - r / 2, g$lon[i] + r / 2, g$lat[i] + r / 2,
    g$lon[i] - r / 2, g$lat[i] + r / 2, g$lon[i] - r / 2, g$lat[i] - r / 2), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))))
  st_sf(g, geometry = st_sfc(polys, crs = 4326))
}
frac_in <- function(gs, poly) {
  a <- as.numeric(st_area(st_transform(gs, 32643)))
  g0 <- st_transform(gs[, "id"], 32643); st_agr(g0) <- "constant"; it <- st_intersection(g0, st_transform(st_union(poly), 32643))
  f <- numeric(nrow(gs)); f[match(it$id, gs$id)] <- as.numeric(st_area(it)) / a[match(it$id, gs$id)]
  f
}
G_sf <- make_grid(glon, glat, res); G_sf$id <- seq_len(nrow(G_sf))
G_sf$w_region <- frac_in(G_sf, region)
G_sf$w_basin  <- frac_in(G_sf, basin)
G_sf$w_basin_chirah <- frac_in(G_sf, basins[grepl("Chirah", basins$name), ])   # v3.1: Chirah catchment (propagation at the Chirah gauge)
for (d in dist$district) G_sf[[paste0("w_", make.names(d))]] <- frac_in(G_sf, dist[dist$district == d, ])
G_sf$z <- terra::extract(dem90, vect(G_sf), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)[, 2]
G_sf$ana <- G_sf$w_region > 0 | G_sf$w_basin > 0
G_sf$frac_region <- G_sf$w_region
G_sf$area_km2 <- 6371.0072^2 * (res * pi / 180) * (sin((G_sf$lat + res / 2) * pi / 180) - sin((G_sf$lat - res / 2) * pi / 180))   # exact spherical cell area (authalic radius, km2)
for (wc in grep("^w_", names(G_sf), value = TRUE)) G_sf[[wc]] <- G_sf[[wc]] * G_sf$area_km2 / mean(G_sf$area_km2)   # v2.1: polygon fraction x cell area
G <- as.data.table(st_drop_geometry(G_sf))
ANA <- G[ana == TRUE]
DCOLS <- grep("^w_(?!region|basin)", names(G), value = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
cat("0.25-deg cells in the analysis domain:", nrow(ANA), "| region-weighted area check (km2):",
    round(sum(ANA$frac_region * as.numeric(st_area(st_transform(G_sf[G_sf$ana, ], 32643))) / 1e6)), "\n")
KEY$n_cells_025 <- nrow(ANA)

dist_tab <- data.table(Unit = dist$district, Province = dist$province, `Area (km²)` = round(dist$area_km2))
# v2.1 (audit c2): Makhad is compared with the published area of the whole Soan basin, not with the Dhok Pathan value
basin_tab[grepl("Makhad", name) & !is.na(published_km2_alt), `:=`(published_km2 = published_km2_alt, difference_pct = 100 * (area_km2 / published_km2_alt - 1))]
basin_tab_out <- basin_tab[, .(Outlet = name, `Lon (°E)` = round(outlet_lon, 3), `Lat (°N)` = round(outlet_lat, 3),
                               `Delineated area (km²)` = round(area_km2, 1), `Published (km²)` = published_km2,
                               `Difference (%)` = round(difference_pct, 1))]
KEY$basin <- basin_tab_out
knitr::kable(dist_tab, caption = "Study-area units (OCHA COD-AB, 2022)")
knitr::kable(basin_tab_out, caption = "Soan basin delineation vs published catchment areas")
```


## Observational data and preprocessing (II-B, III-B)

### Station records: QC, gap filling and homogeneity

Station data were taken from **every NOAA GSOD/ISD and GHCN-Daily station within 100 km** of the four districts and ICT (open; DEVIATIONS D4). They were downloaded raw by `01k_download_stations.py`, and parsing and gross-error QC are done below. GSOD and GHCN-D records of the same WMO station were merged; GHCN-D precipitation without quality flags was preferred, then GSOD daily totals not flagged incomplete ("I").
**v3: PMD daily records** (precipitation, Tmax and Tmin, 1961–2010) for **Islamabad** and **Murree**, supplied by the author, were parsed and checked by `scripts/05_read_pmd_wapda.R` (missing code −99.9, trace 0.01 mm → 0, gross-error limits, 2004 Islamabad re-dated: 29 Feb missing and 31 Dec repeated in the labels). PMD Murree is the same station as GSOD Murree (WMO 41573), and PMD Islamabad agrees best with GSOD Islamabad City (WMO 41577); daily P at Chaklala correlates with it at r ≈ 0.35 only, so Chaklala is kept as a separate station. In these two records PMD values replace the GSOD values of P, Tmax and Tmin; GSOD supplies dew point and wind and the years after 2010. Because neither station reports humidity or wind continuously, their dew point and 10 m wind are completed over the whole record (not only gaps of ≤15 days) by month-wise quantile mapping of ERA5-Land at the station point to the station's own GSOD observations (DEVIATIONS D22).
Gap filling (Methodology III-B): all gaps of ≤15 days were filled by **empirical quantile mapping** (per calendar month) of the co-located daily CHIRPS (precipitation) and ERA5-Land (Tmax, Tmin, dew point, 10 m wind) values. These values were extracted at each station through Google Earth Engine. Longer gaps were left missing, and a month counts as complete only if every day was observed or filled.
A station was **accepted if ≥70% of its months in 1985–2014 were complete**: for precipitation (SPI) and, for SPEI and ET₀, also for the Penman–Monteith inputs. Homogeneity was assessed on annual series with SNHT and the Pettitt test (α = 0.05).

```{r stations}
SV2 <- file.path(RAW, "stations_v2")
cand <- fread(file.path(SV2, "candidate_stations.csv"), colClasses = list(character = c("key", "begin", "end")))
cand[, wmo := fifelse(source == "GSOD", substr(key, 1, 5),
              fifelse(grepl("^[A-Z]{2}M000|^PK0000", key), substr(key, 7, 11), NA_character_))]
cand[, sid := fifelse(!is.na(wmo) & wmo != "99999", paste0("WMO", wmo), key)]
LAB <- unique(cand[order(source), .(sid, name = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gsub("\\*", "", name))))], by = "sid")
LAB[, label := if (.N > 1) paste0(name, " (", sid, ")") else name, by = name]    # unique station labels
num0 <- function(x, miss) { x <- trimws(x); ok <- grepl("^[-+]?([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*|\\.[0-9]+)([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$", x); v <- rep(NA_real_, length(x)); v[ok] <- as.numeric(x[ok]); v[!is.na(v) & v >= miss] <- NA; v }
read_gsod <- function(k) {
  fs <- list.files(file.path(SV2, "gsod"), pattern = paste0("^", k, "\\.csv$"), recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(fs)) return(NULL)
  d <- rbindlist(lapply(fs, fread, colClasses = "character"), fill = TRUE)
  data.table(date = as.IDate(d$DATE), tmax = (num0(d$MAX, 9999) - 32) / 1.8, tmin = (num0(d$MIN, 9999) - 32) / 1.8,
             tdew = (num0(d$DEWP, 9999) - 32) / 1.8, wind10 = num0(d$WDSP, 999) * 0.514444,    # knots -> m/s
             prcp_gsod = num0(d$PRCP, 99.99) * 25.4, prcp_flag = trimws(d$PRCP_ATTRIBUTES))      # inches -> mm
}
read_ghcn <- function(k) {
  f <- file.path(SV2, "ghcnd", paste0(k, ".csv.gz")); if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  d <- fread(f, header = FALSE, col.names = c("id", "date", "el", "val", "m", "q", "s", "t"), colClasses = list(character = c(2, 5, 6, 7)))
  d <- d[el %in% c("PRCP", "TMAX", "TMIN") & (is.na(q) | q == "")]
  d[, date := as.IDate(date, format = "%Y%m%d")]
  dcast(d, date ~ el, value.var = "val", fun.aggregate = function(x) x[1] / 10)[, setnames(.SD, intersect(c("PRCP", "TMAX", "TMIN"), names(.SD)),
    c(PRCP = "prcp_ghcn", TMAX = "tmax_ghcn", TMIN = "tmin_ghcn")[intersect(c("PRCP", "TMAX", "TMIN"), names(.SD))])]
}
read_gee <- function(src, k) {
  f <- file.path(SV2, "gee_points", paste0(src, "_", k, ".csv")); if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  g <- fread(f); g[, date := as.IDate(date)]
  g[, .(date, e5_tmax = temperature_2m_max - 273.15, e5_tmin = temperature_2m_min - 273.15, e5_tdew = dewpoint_temperature_2m - 273.15,
        e5_wind = sqrt(u_component_of_wind_10m^2 + v_component_of_wind_10m^2), e5_pr = total_precipitation_sum * 1000, chirps_pr)]
}
STN <- cached("stations_v2_raw", rbindlist(lapply(unique(cand$sid), function(s) {
  cs <- cand[sid == s]; days <- data.table(date = seq(as.IDate("1981-01-01"), as.IDate("2024-12-31"), by = 1))
  gs <- rbindlist(lapply(cs[source == "GSOD"]$key, read_gsod)); gh <- rbindlist(lapply(cs[source == "GHCN-D"]$key, read_ghcn), fill = TRUE)
  if (!nrow(gs) && !nrow(gh)) return(NULL)
  x <- days
  if (nrow(gs)) x <- merge(x, gs[!duplicated(date)], by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
  if (nrow(gh)) x <- merge(x, gh[!duplicated(date)], by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
  for (v in c("tmax", "tmin", "tdew", "wind10", "prcp_gsod", "prcp_ghcn", "tmax_ghcn", "tmin_ghcn")) if (!v %in% names(x)) x[[v]] <- NA_real_
  if (!"prcp_flag" %in% names(x)) x[["prcp_flag"]] <- NA_character_
  x[is.na(prcp_flag), prcp_flag := ""]
  ge <- read_gee(cs$source[1], cs$key[1]); if (!is.null(ge)) x <- merge(x, ge, by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
  x[, tmax := fifelse(is.na(tmax), as.numeric(tmax_ghcn), tmax)][, tmin := fifelse(is.na(tmin), as.numeric(tmin_ghcn), tmin)]
  x[, prcp := fifelse(!is.na(prcp_ghcn), as.numeric(prcp_ghcn), fifelse(prcp_flag != "I", prcp_gsod, NA_real_))]
  # gross-error QC (WMO-type limits)
  x[tmax < -25 | tmax > 52, tmax := NA][tmin < -25 | tmin > 45, tmin := NA][!is.na(tmax) & !is.na(tmin) & tmax < tmin, c("tmax", "tmin") := .(NA, NA)]
  x[prcp < 0 | prcp > 400, prcp := NA][wind10 < 0 | wind10 > 40, wind10 := NA][!is.na(tdew) & !is.na(tmax) & tdew > tmax + 1, tdew := NA]
  cbind(station = LAB[sid == s, label], sid = s, lat = cs$lat[1], lon = cs$lon[1], elev_m = cs$elev[1], dist_km = min(cs$dist_km),
        x[, .(date, tmax, tmin, tdew, wind10, prcp, e5_tmax, e5_tmin, e5_tdew, e5_wind, e5_pr, chirps_pr)])
})))
SD <- copy(STN)
# v3: PMD daily P, Tmax, Tmin (scripts/05_read_pmd_wapda.R) replace the GSOD values of the same station where available
PMD <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "pmd", "pmd_stations_daily.csv"))[, date := as.IDate(date)]
PMD_SID <- c(Islamabad = "WMO41577", Murree = "WMO41573")
SD[, src_p := fifelse(is.na(prcp), "", "GSOD/GHCN-D")]
for (p in names(PMD_SID)) { i <- which(SD$sid == PMD_SID[[p]]); stopifnot(length(i) > 0)
  x <- PMD[station == p][match(SD$date[i], date)]
  SD[i, `:=`(prcp = fifelse(!is.na(x$prcp), x$prcp, prcp), tmax = fifelse(!is.na(x$tmax), x$tmax, tmax), tmin = fifelse(!is.na(x$tmin), x$tmin, tmin),
             src_p = fifelse(!is.na(x$prcp), "PMD", src_p))] }
SD[sid %in% PMD_SID, station := paste0(names(PMD_SID)[match(sid, PMD_SID)], " (PMD)")]
KEY$pmd_share_days <- SD[sid %in% PMD_SID, .(pmd_pct_P_1981_2010 = round(100 * mean(src_p[year(date) <= 2010] == "PMD"), 1),
                                            gsod_P_days_2011_2024 = sum(src_p[year(date) > 2010] != "")), by = station]
KEY$pmd_qc <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "pmd", "pmd_qc_log.csv"))[n > 0]
SD[, `:=`(month = month(date), year = year(date))]
smeta <- unique(SD[, .(station, sid, lat, lon, elev_m, dist_km)])
smeta[, role := fifelse(dist_km == 0, "inside plateau", paste0(round(dist_km), " km outside"))]
smeta[is.na(elev_m), elev_m := terra::extract(dem90, cbind(lon, lat))[is.na(elev_m), 1]]

gap_runs <- function(x, maxgap = 15) { r <- rle(is.na(x)); len <- rep(r$lengths, r$lengths); val <- rep(r$values, r$lengths); val & len <= maxgap }
qm_fill <- function(obs, ref, month, maxgap = 15) {          # empirical quantile mapping ref -> obs, per calendar month
  out <- obs; short <- gap_runs(obs, maxgap)
  for (m in 1:12) {
    i <- month == m; ok <- i & !is.na(obs) & !is.na(ref)
    if (sum(ok) < 60) next
    Fr <- ecdf(ref[ok]); tgt <- i & short & !is.na(ref)
    out[tgt] <- as.numeric(quantile(obs[ok], probs = Fr(ref[tgt]), type = 8, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  out
}
clim_fill <- function(obs, month) { out <- obs; short <- gap_runs(obs)
  cl <- tapply(obs, month, mean, na.rm = TRUE); out[short] <- cl[month[short]]; out }
SD <- SD[order(station, date)]
SD[, `:=`(prcp_f = qm_fill(prcp, chirps_pr, month), tmax_f = qm_fill(tmax, e5_tmax, month),
          tmin_f = qm_fill(tmin, e5_tmin, month),
          tdew_f15 = qm_fill(tdew, e5_tdew, month), wind_f15 = qm_fill(wind10, e5_wind, month),          # methodology rule: gaps <= 15 days
          tdew_f = qm_fill(tdew, e5_tdew, month, if (sid[1] %in% PMD_SID) Inf else 15),
          wind_f = qm_fill(wind10, e5_wind, month, if (sid[1] %in% PMD_SID) Inf else 15)),   # v3 (D22): PMD stations, full-record humidity/wind
   by = station]
# Islamabad City has almost no GSOD dew point or wind (fewer than 60 days per calendar month), so the gap-filled Chaklala series
# (11 km away, 17 m lower, same 0.25 deg cell) is used where Islamabad's own value is missing (an observation, not reanalysis)
ck <- SD[station == "Chaklala", .(date, ck_tdew = tdew_f15, ck_wind = wind_f15)]
SD[ck, on = "date", `:=`(tdew_f = fifelse(station == "Islamabad (PMD)" & is.na(tdew_f), i.ck_tdew, tdew_f),
                         wind_f = fifelse(station == "Islamabad (PMD)" & is.na(wind_f), i.ck_wind, wind_f),
                         tdew_f15 = fifelse(station == "Islamabad (PMD)" & is.na(tdew_f15), i.ck_tdew, tdew_f15),
                         wind_f15 = fifelse(station == "Islamabad (PMD)" & is.na(wind_f15), i.ck_wind, wind_f15))]
KEY$pmd_hum_wind_obs_pct <- SD[sid %in% PMD_SID & year %between% BASE, .(tdew_obs_pct = 100 * mean(!is.na(tdew)), wind_obs_pct = 100 * mean(!is.na(wind10))), by = station]
SD[!is.na(tmax_f) & !is.na(tmin_f) & tmax_f < tmin_f, c("tmax_f", "tmin_f") := .(NA, NA)]
SD[, filled_p := is.na(prcp) & !is.na(prcp_f)]
SD[, hw_obs := !is.na(tdew_f15) & !is.na(wind_f15)]   # humidity and wind observed (or short-gap filled) on this day
KEY$station_fill_pct <- SD[, .(p = 100 * mean(filled_p)), by = station]
```

**FAO-56 Penman–Monteith reference evapotranspiration (Eq. 1).** ET₀ was implemented directly from FAO-56 [33]. For daily station data: e_a from dew point; u₂ = 0.748·u₁₀ (log profile, FAO-56 Eq. 47); R_s from the FAO-56 temperature-based formula (Eq. 50, k_Rs = 0.16 for interior locations) because sunshine and radiation are not reported; G = 0. For monthly grids: G = 0.14(T_i − T_{i−1}) (FAO-56 Eq. 44). Hargreaves (FAO-56 Eq. 52) was computed only for the sensitivity test.

```{r et0-functions}
e0  <- function(T) 0.6108 * exp(17.27 * T / (T + 237.3))
ra_mj <- function(lat, J) {                        # extraterrestrial radiation, MJ m-2 d-1 (FAO-56 Eq. 21)
  phi <- lat * pi / 180; dr <- 1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi * J / 365); dl <- 0.409 * sin(2 * pi * J / 365 - 1.39)
  ws <- acos(pmin(pmax(-tan(phi) * tan(dl), -1), 1))
  24 * 60 / pi * 0.0820 * dr * (ws * sin(phi) * sin(dl) + cos(phi) * cos(dl) * sin(ws))
}
fao56_pm <- function(tmax, tmin, rs, u2, ea, z, lat, J, G = 0) {   # Eq. (1); mm d-1
  Tm <- (tmax + tmin) / 2
  delta <- 4098 * e0(Tm) / (Tm + 237.3)^2
  P <- 101.3 * ((293 - 0.0065 * z) / 293)^5.26; gam <- 0.000665 * P
  es <- (e0(tmax) + e0(tmin)) / 2; ea <- pmin(ea, es)
  Ra <- ra_mj(lat, J); Rso <- (0.75 + 2e-5 * z) * Ra
  rs <- pmin(rs, Rso)                               # Rs cannot exceed clear-sky radiation
  Rns <- 0.77 * rs
  Rnl <- 4.903e-9 * ((tmax + 273.16)^4 + (tmin + 273.16)^4) / 2 * (0.34 - 0.14 * sqrt(pmax(ea, 0))) *
         (1.35 * pmin(rs / Rso, 1) - 0.35)
  Rn <- Rns - Rnl
  et <- (0.408 * delta * (Rn - G) + gam * 900 / (Tm + 273) * u2 * (es - ea)) / (delta + gam * (1 + 0.34 * u2))
  pmax(et, 0)
}
hargreaves_et0 <- function(tmax, tmin, lat, J) {   # FAO-56 Eq. 52; mm d-1 (sensitivity only)
  pmax(0.0023 * ((tmax + tmin) / 2 + 17.8) * sqrt(pmax(tmax - tmin, 0)) * 0.408 * ra_mj(lat, J), 0)
}
U2 <- function(u10) u10 * 4.87 / log(67.8 * 10 - 5.42)
mid_doy <- function(m) as.integer(30.4 * m - 15)                       # FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998), mid-month day of year
std_days <- function(m) c(31, 28.25, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31)[m]   # only when no dates are known
# monthly PM on [time x cell] matrices; G from the month-to-month change in mean temperature (FAO-56 Eq. 44)
pm_monthly <- function(tmax, tmin, rs, u10, ea, z, lat, months, ndays = std_days(months)) {
  nt <- nrow(tmax); Z <- matrix(z, nt, ncol(tmax), byrow = TRUE); L <- matrix(lat, nt, ncol(tmax), byrow = TRUE)
  J <- matrix(mid_doy(months), nt, ncol(tmax)); Tm <- (tmax + tmin) / 2
  G <- 0.14 * (Tm - rbind(Tm[1, , drop = FALSE], Tm[-nt, , drop = FALSE]))
  et <- fao56_pm(tmax, tmin, rs, U2(u10), ea, Z, L, J, G)
  et * matrix(ndays, nt, ncol(tmax))
}
hg_monthly <- function(tmax, tmin, lat, months, ndays = std_days(months)) {
  nt <- nrow(tmax); L <- matrix(lat, nt, ncol(tmax), byrow = TRUE); J <- matrix(mid_doy(months), nt, ncol(tmax))
  hargreaves_et0(tmax, tmin, L, J) * matrix(ndays, nt, ncol(tmax))
}
# cross-check of the implementation against SPEI::penman (FAO method) on one synthetic year
chk <- SPEI::penman(Tmin = 10 + 8 * sin(1:12 / 2), Tmax = 24 + 8 * sin(1:12 / 2), U2 = rep(2, 12), Rs = rep(18, 12),
                    ed = rep(1.2, 12), lat = 33.6, z = 500, method = "FAO", verbose = FALSE)
own <- pm_monthly(matrix(24 + 8 * sin(1:12 / 2)), matrix(10 + 8 * sin(1:12 / 2)), matrix(18, 12, 1), matrix(2 / 0.748, 12, 1),
                  matrix(1.2, 12, 1), 500, 33.6, 1:12)
KEY$pm_check_r <- round(cor(as.numeric(chk), as.numeric(own)), 4)
cat("Correlation of this FAO-56 implementation with SPEI::penman(method='FAO'):", KEY$pm_check_r, "\n")
```

```{r stations-monthly}
SD[, `:=`(J = yday(date), ea = e0(tdew_f))]
SD[, rs :=pmin(0.16 * sqrt(pmax(tmax_f - tmin_f, 0)) * ra_mj(lat, J), (0.75 + 2e-5 * elev_m) * ra_mj(lat, J))]
SD[, et0_pm := fao56_pm(tmax_f, tmin_f, rs, U2(wind_f), ea, elev_m, lat, J)]
SD[, et0_hg := hargreaves_et0(tmax_f, tmin_f, lat, J)]
# reference series at the station point for relative homogeneity tests (v3.1): CHIRPS P, ERA5-Land Tmax/Tmin and ERA5-Land PM ET0
# (same FAO-56 routine and temperature-based Rs as the station, so that the ratio isolates the station record)
SD[, et0_ref := fao56_pm(e5_tmax, e5_tmin, pmin(0.16 * sqrt(pmax(e5_tmax - e5_tmin, 0)) * ra_mj(lat, J), (0.75 + 2e-5 * elev_m) * ra_mj(lat, J)),
                         U2(e5_wind), e0(e5_tdew), elev_m, lat, J)]

             ET0 = if (all(!is.na(et0_pm))) sum(et0_pm) else NA_real_,
             ET0_HG = if (all(!is.na(et0_hg))) sum(et0_hg) else NA_real_,
             Tmax = if (mean(!is.na(tmax_f)) >= 0.9) mean(tmax_f, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
             Tmin = if (mean(!is.na(tmin_f)) >= 0.9) mean(tmin_f, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
             ET0_hw_obs = all(!is.na(et0_pm)) && all(hw_obs),                          # ET0 month with observed humidity and wind
             P_ref = sum(chirps_pr), ET0_ref = sum(et0_ref),
             Tmax_ref = mean(e5_tmax[!is.na(tmax_f)]), Tmin_ref = mean(e5_tmin[!is.na(tmin_f)]),
             n = .N), by = .(station, year, month)]
SM[, date := as.IDate(sprintf("%d-%02d-15", year, month))]
comp <- SM[year >= BASE[1] & year <= BASE[2], .(base_P = mean(!is.na(P)), base_ET0 = mean(!is.na(ET0)), base_ET0_obs = mean(ET0_hw_obs)), by = station]
comp_all <- SM[, .(all_P = mean(!is.na(P)), all_ET0 = mean(!is.na(ET0))), by = station]
comp <- merge(comp, comp_all, by = "station")
comp[, used_P := base_P >= 0.7][, used := base_P >= 0.7 & base_ET0 >= 0.7]
ST_USED <- comp[used == TRUE, station]          # P and PM ET0: SPI, SPEI, RDI
ST_USED_P <- comp[used_P == TRUE, station]      # precipitation only: SPI
cat("Stations accepted (>=70% complete months 1985-2014) for P + ET0:", paste(ST_USED, collapse = ", "),
    "| P only:", paste(setdiff(ST_USED_P, ST_USED), collapse = ", "), "\n")
KEY$stations_v2 <- list(n_candidates = nrow(smeta), accepted_P_ET0 = ST_USED, accepted_P_only = setdiff(ST_USED_P, ST_USED))
SM <- merge(SM, smeta[, .(station, lat, lon, elev_m)], by = "station")

# homogeneity on annual series (years with 12 valid months)
homog <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) < 20) return(c(snht_p = NA_real_, pett_p = NA_real_, cp = NA_real_))
  s <- trend::snh.test(x, m = 2000); p <- trend::pettitt.test(x)
  c(snht_p = s$p.value, pett_p = as.numeric(p$p.value), cp = as.numeric(p$estimate))
}
# v3.1: relative homogeneity (Alexandersson's SNHT is a relative test). Candidate/reference series on the same months:
# ratio for P and ET0, difference for Tmax and Tmin; reference = CHIRPS (P) and ERA5-Land (Tmax, Tmin, PM ET0) at the station point.
# The absolute tests of v2.2 are kept in the CSV for comparison.
ANN <- SM[, .(P = if (sum(!is.na(P)) == 12) sum(P) else NA_real_, ET0 = if (sum(!is.na(ET0)) == 12) sum(ET0) else NA_real_,
              Tmax = if (sum(!is.na(Tmax)) == 12) mean(Tmax) else NA_real_, Tmin = if (sum(!is.na(Tmin)) == 12) mean(Tmin) else NA_real_,
              P_ref = if (sum(!is.na(P)) == 12) sum(P_ref) else NA_real_, ET0_ref = if (sum(!is.na(ET0)) == 12) sum(ET0_ref) else NA_real_,
              Tmax_ref = if (sum(!is.na(Tmax)) == 12) mean(Tmax_ref) else NA_real_, Tmin_ref = if (sum(!is.na(Tmin)) == 12) mean(Tmin_ref) else NA_real_),
          by = .(station, year)]
ANN[, `:=`(P_rel = P / P_ref, ET0_rel = ET0 / ET0_ref, Tmax_rel = Tmax - Tmax_ref, Tmin_rel = Tmin - Tmin_ref)]
hclass <- function(s, p) fifelse(is.na(s), "insufficient", fifelse(s >= 0.05 & p >= 0.05, "homogeneous", fifelse(s < 0.05 & p < 0.05, "suspect", "doubtful")))
set.seed(SEED)
HOM <- ANN[, {
  r <- lapply(c("P", "Tmax", "Tmin", "ET0"), function(v) { h <- homog(get(paste0(v, "_rel"))); yrs <- year[!is.na(get(paste0(v, "_rel")))]
    a <- homog(get(v))
    data.table(variable = v, n_years = length(yrs), snht_p = as.numeric(h[1]), pettitt_p = as.numeric(h[2]),
               change_year = if (!is.na(h[3])) as.integer(yrs[h[3]]) else NA_integer_, snht_p_abs = as.numeric(a[1]), pettitt_p_abs = as.numeric(a[2])) })
  rbindlist(r) }, by = station]
HOM[, `:=`(class = hclass(snht_p, pettitt_p), class_abs = hclass(snht_p_abs, pettitt_p_abs))]
fwrite(SM, file.path(ROOT, "02_obs_preprocess", "stations_monthly.csv"))   # eligibility and Table 1: chunk station-eligibility (needs the gridded references)
```

### Gridded observations at 0.25° and 0.05°

CHIRPS v2.0 provided precipitation. As the methodology specifies, the **Penman–Monteith inputs came from ERA5-Land** (Google Earth Engine; `01i_gee_downloads.py`). These were Tmax and Tmin (monthly means of daily extremes), dew point, surface solar radiation, and **10 m wind speed computed as the monthly mean of hourly √(u²+v²)**, because the monthly vector-mean components would underestimate speed. GEE aggregated each field onto the analysis grids by area-weighted averaging.
**TerraClimate** (Tmax, Tmin, vapour pressure, R_s, wind) supplies a second, independent PM estimate used as a sensitivity run (DEVIATIONS D9, v2). TerraClimate PET and CRU TS 4.10 PET serve as independent references.

```{r obs-grids}
nc_mat <- function(file, var, cells, lons = glon, lats = glat) {   # -> [time x cells]
  nc <- nc_open(file); on.exit(nc_close(nc))
  a <- ncvar_get(nc, var, collapse_degen = FALSE)                  # [lon, lat, time]
  lo <- round(ncvar_get(nc, "lon"), 3); la <- round(ncvar_get(nc, "lat"), 3)
  il <- match(cells$lon, lo); ia <- match(cells$lat, la)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(il), !anyNA(ia))
  tt <- ncvar_get(nc, "time"); tu <- ncatt_get(nc, "time", "units")$value
  org <- as.Date(sub(".*since ([0-9-]+).*", "\\1", tu))
  dates <- if (grepl("^days", tu)) org + tt else if (grepl("^hours", tu)) org + tt / 24 else stop(tu)
  m <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(i) a[il[i], ia[i], ])
  if (is.null(dim(m))) m <- matrix(m, ncol = nrow(cells))
  attr(m, "dates") <- as.Date(format(dates, "%Y-%m-15")); m
}
OBSF <- file.path(ROOT, "02_obs_preprocess")
OBS <- cached("obs_grids_025", {
  o <- list()
  o$chirps_pr <- nc_mat(file.path(OBSF, "obs_monthly_chirps.nc"), "pr", ANA)
  for (v in c("pr", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin")) o[[paste0("e5l_", v)]] <- nc_mat(file.path(OBSF, "obs_monthly_era5land.nc"), v, ANA)
  for (v in c("tasmax", "tasmin", "vap", "rsds", "sfcWind", "pet", "pr")) o[[paste0("tc_", v)]] <- nc_mat(file.path(OBSF, "obs_monthly_terraclimate.nc"), v, ANA)
  for (v in c("pr", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin", "pet", "vap")) o[[paste0("cru_", v)]] <- nc_mat(file.path(OBSF, "obs_monthly_cru.nc"), v, ANA)
  # ERA5-Land PM inputs (GEE, already on the 0.25 deg grid)
  ef <- file.path(RAW, "gee", "era5land_pm_inputs_025.nc")
  for (v in c("temperature_2m_max", "temperature_2m_min", "dewpoint_temperature_2m", "surface_solar_radiation_downwards_sum",
              "wind_speed_10m", "surface_pressure")) o[[paste0("e5pm_", v)]] <- nc_mat(ef, v, ANA)
  o
})
DATES_OBS <- attr(OBS$chirps_pr, "dates"); MON_OBS <- as.integer(format(DATES_OBS, "%m")); YR_OBS <- as.integer(format(DATES_OBS, "%Y"))
stopifnot(all(attr(OBS$tc_tasmax, "dates") == DATES_OBS), all(attr(OBS$e5pm_wind_speed_10m, "dates") == DATES_OBS))
days_in_month <- function(d) { f <- as.Date(format(d, "%Y-%m-01")); as.integer(format(seq(f[1], by = "month", length.out = length(f) + 1)[-1] - 1, "%d")) }
DIM <- matrix(days_in_month(DATES_OBS), length(DATES_OBS), nrow(ANA))   # consecutive months
# ---- ERA5-Land (primary) PM inputs in FAO-56 units ----
OBS$e5_tasmax <- OBS$e5pm_temperature_2m_max - 273.15; OBS$e5_tasmin <- OBS$e5pm_temperature_2m_min - 273.15
OBS$e5_vap <- e0(OBS$e5pm_dewpoint_temperature_2m - 273.15)                        # actual vapour pressure (kPa)
OBS$e5_rsds <- OBS$e5pm_surface_solar_radiation_downwards_sum / DIM / 1e6          # J m-2 month-1 -> MJ m-2 d-1
OBS$e5_sfcWind <- OBS$e5pm_wind_speed_10m                                         # m s-1 at 10 m (hourly-derived mean speed)
OBS$e5_hurs <- pmin(100 * OBS$e5_vap / ((e0(OBS$e5_tasmax) + e0(OBS$e5_tasmin)) / 2), 100)
OBS$pm_et0 <- pm_monthly(OBS$e5_tasmax, OBS$e5_tasmin, OBS$e5_rsds, OBS$e5_sfcWind, OBS$e5_vap, ANA$z, ANA$lat, MON_OBS, DIM[, 1])   # PRIMARY
OBS$hg_et0 <- hg_monthly(OBS$e5_tasmax, OBS$e5_tasmin, ANA$lat, MON_OBS, DIM[, 1])
# ---- TerraClimate (sensitivity) ----
OBS$pm_et0_tc <- pm_monthly(OBS$tc_tasmax, OBS$tc_tasmin, OBS$tc_rsds, OBS$tc_sfcWind, OBS$tc_vap, ANA$z, ANA$lat, MON_OBS, DIM[, 1])
OBS$tc_hurs <- pmin(100 * OBS$tc_vap / ((e0(OBS$tc_tasmax) + e0(OBS$tc_tasmin)) / 2), 100)   # matrix first: keeps dims
wmean <- function(M, w) as.numeric(M %*% w / sum(w))        # area-weighted regional mean of [time x cell]
W_REG <- ANA$w_region; W_BAS <- ANA$w_basin
REG <- data.table(date = DATES_OBS, year = YR_OBS, month = MON_OBS,
                  P_chirps = wmean(OBS$chirps_pr, W_REG), P_e5l = wmean(OBS$e5l_pr, W_REG), P_cru = wmean(OBS$cru_pr, W_REG),
                  P_tc = wmean(OBS$tc_pr, W_REG), ET0_pm = wmean(OBS$pm_et0, W_REG), ET0_hg = wmean(OBS$hg_et0, W_REG),
                  ET0_pm_tc = wmean(OBS$pm_et0_tc, W_REG), PET_tc = wmean(OBS$tc_pet, W_REG), PET_cru = wmean(OBS$cru_pet, W_REG),
                  Tmax = wmean(OBS$e5_tasmax, W_REG), Tmin = wmean(OBS$e5_tasmin, W_REG))
annual_clim <- REG[year >= BASE[1] & year <= BASE[2], lapply(.SD, sum), by = year, .SDcols = patterns("^P_|^ET0|^PET")][, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = -"year"]
KEY$obs_annual_clim_1985_2014 <- annual_clim   # v3.1: full precision; rounded once when printed
knitr::kable(round(annual_clim), caption = "Regional (4 districts + ICT) annual climatology 1985–2014 (mm)")
monsoon_share <- REG[year >= BASE[1] & year <= BASE[2], .(m = sum(P_chirps[month %in% 6:9]) / sum(P_chirps)), by = year][, mean(m)]
KEY$monsoon_share_pct <- 100 * monsoon_share
cat("Share of annual CHIRPS rainfall in June-September (1985-2014):", KEY$monsoon_share_pct, "%\n")
```

```{r station-eligibility}
# ---- v3.1 station eligibility for every station-based evaluation (GCM station KGE, ET0 skill, station vs gridded indices) ----
# (i) representativeness: |station elevation - mean elevation of its 0.25 deg cell| <= indices.station_dz_max (point-to-grid comparison);
# (ii) relative homogeneity, confirmed against two independent references: a series is "suspect" only if SNHT and Pettitt both reject
#      against CHIRPS/ERA5-Land at the station point (stations-monthly) AND against TerraClimate at the station cell (a break shared by
#      distant stations in one reference is a reference artefact, not a station inhomogeneity); suspect series are not used;
# (iii) ET0 only where >= 70% of 1985-2014 months have observed (or short-gap filled) humidity and wind, so that no reanalysis-derived
#      ET0 is compared with the reanalysis it was derived from. Stations sharing a cell are averaged into one cell value (ranking_helpers.R).
st_cells <- sapply(ST_USED, function(s) { r <- smeta[station == s]; which.min((ANA$lon - r$lon)^2 + (ANA$lat - r$lat)^2) })
st_in <- sapply(ST_USED, function(s) { r <- smeta[station == s]; min(abs(ANA$lon - r$lon)) <= 0.125 & min(abs(ANA$lat - r$lat)) <= 0.125 })
st_dz <- setNames(smeta[match(ST_USED, station), elev_m] - ANA$z[st_cells], ST_USED)
DZ_MAX <- cfg$indices$station_dz_max; KEY$station_dz_max <- DZ_MAX
# second reference: TerraClimate P, Tmax, Tmin and PM ET0 at the station cell (stations inside the analysis domain)
TCREF <- rbindlist(lapply(ST_USED[st_in], function(s) { j <- st_cells[[s]]
  data.table(station = s, year = YR_OBS, month = MON_OBS, P_tc = OBS$tc_pr[, j], ET0_tc = OBS$pm_et0_tc[, j], Tmax_tc = OBS$tc_tasmax[, j], Tmin_tc = OBS$tc_tasmin[, j]) }))
A2 <- merge(SM[station %in% ST_USED[st_in], .(station, year, month, P, ET0, Tmax, Tmin)], TCREF, by = c("station", "year", "month"))
A2 <- A2[, .(P_rel = if (sum(!is.na(P) & !is.na(P_tc)) == 12) sum(P) / sum(P_tc) else NA_real_, ET0_rel = if (sum(!is.na(ET0) & !is.na(ET0_tc)) == 12) sum(ET0) / sum(ET0_tc) else NA_real_,
             Tmax_rel = if (sum(!is.na(Tmax) & !is.na(Tmax_tc)) == 12) mean(Tmax - Tmax_tc) else NA_real_, Tmin_rel = if (sum(!is.na(Tmin) & !is.na(Tmin_tc)) == 12) mean(Tmin - Tmin_tc) else NA_real_),
         by = .(station, year)]
set.seed(SEED)
HOM_TC <- A2[, rbindlist(lapply(c("P", "Tmax", "Tmin", "ET0"), function(v) { h <- homog(get(paste0(v, "_rel"))); yrs <- year[!is.na(get(paste0(v, "_rel")))]
  data.table(variable = v, snht_p_tc = as.numeric(h[1]), pettitt_p_tc = as.numeric(h[2]), change_year_tc = if (!is.na(h[3])) as.integer(yrs[h[3]]) else NA_integer_) })), by = station]
HOM <- merge(HOM, HOM_TC, by = c("station", "variable"), all.x = TRUE)
HOM[, `:=`(class_e5 = class, class_tc = hclass(snht_p_tc, pettitt_p_tc))]
HOM[, class := fifelse(class_e5 == "suspect" & class_tc == "suspect", "suspect",
                fifelse(class_e5 == "homogeneous" & class_tc %in% c("homogeneous", "insufficient"), "homogeneous",
                fifelse(class_e5 == "insufficient" & class_tc == "insufficient", "insufficient", "doubtful")))]
HOM[is.na(class), class := class_e5]   # stations outside the domain: only the CHIRPS/ERA5-Land test exists
ST_EVAL <- ST_USED[st_in & abs(st_dz) <= DZ_MAX]
ST_ET0_OBS <- comp[base_ET0_obs >= 0.7, station]
suspect <- function(v) HOM[variable == v & class == "suspect", station]
ST_EVAL_V <- list(pr = setdiff(ST_EVAL, suspect("P")), tasmax = setdiff(ST_EVAL, suspect("Tmax")), tasmin = setdiff(ST_EVAL, suspect("Tmin")),
                  ET0 = intersect(setdiff(ST_EVAL, suspect("ET0")), ST_ET0_OBS))
KEY$station_vars_without_eligible_station <- names(ST_EVAL_V)[lengths(ST_EVAL_V) == 0]   # their station criterion is dropped from the ranking
KEY$station_eligibility <- data.table(station = ST_USED, in_domain = st_in, dz_cell_m = st_dz, representative = abs(st_dz) <= DZ_MAX,
  hum_wind_obs_pct = 100 * comp[match(ST_USED, station), base_ET0_obs],
  eval_P = ST_USED %in% ST_EVAL_V$pr, eval_Tmax = ST_USED %in% ST_EVAL_V$tasmax, eval_Tmin = ST_USED %in% ST_EVAL_V$tasmin, eval_ET0 = ST_USED %in% ST_EVAL_V$ET0,
  cell = st_cells)
KEY$homogeneity <- HOM
T1 <- merge(smeta[, .(Station = station, Role = role, `Lat (°N)` = round(lat, 3), `Lon (°E)` = round(lon, 3), `Elev. (m)` = round(elev_m))],
            comp[, .(Station = station, `P compl. 1985–2014 (%)` = round(100 * base_P), `ET0 compl. 1985–2014 (%)` = round(100 * base_ET0),
                     `Obs. humidity/wind 1985–2014 (%)` = round(100 * base_ET0_obs), `P compl. 1981–2024 (%)` = round(100 * all_P))], by = "Station")
H2 <- dcast(HOM, station ~ variable, value.var = "class"); setnames(H2, "station", "Station")
setnames(H2, c("P", "Tmax", "Tmin", "ET0"), paste0("Homog. ", c("P", "Tmax", "Tmin", "ET0")), skip_absent = TRUE)
T1 <- merge(T1, H2, by = "Station", all.x = TRUE)
T1[, Used := fifelse(Station %in% ST_USED, "P + ET0", fifelse(Station %in% ST_USED_P, "P only", "no"))]
EL <- KEY$station_eligibility
T1[, `Evaluated for` := sapply(Station, function(s) { e <- EL[station == s]; if (!nrow(e)) return("–")
  v <- c("P", "Tmax", "Tmin", "ET0")[unlist(e[, .(eval_P, eval_Tmax, eval_Tmin, eval_ET0)])]; if (length(v)) paste(v, collapse = ", ") else "none" })]
setorder(T1, -Used, Station)
fwrite(HOM, file.path(ROOT, "02_obs_preprocess", "station_homogeneity_tests.csv"))
save_table(T1, 1, "Station quality control, completeness and relative homogeneity (SNHT and Pettitt, α = 0.05)", "Table1_station_QC_homogeneity",
           note = paste0("Relative tests on station/reference ratios (P, ET0) or differences (Tmax, Tmin) against two references: CHIRPS and ERA5-Land at the station point, and TerraClimate at the station cell. ",
                         "Suspect: both tests reject against both references (not used for that variable); homogeneous: no rejection against either reference; doubtful: otherwise. ",
                         "Evaluated for: variables used in the GCM station KGE, the ET0 skill and the station vs gridded comparison (station in the domain, |elevation − cell mean| ≤ ", DZ_MAX, " m, not suspect; ET0 also needs ≥ 70% observed humidity/wind). ",
                         "Sources: NOAA GSOD and GHCN-Daily; Islamabad (PMD) and Murree (PMD): PMD daily P, Tmax and Tmin 1961–2010 (GSOD after 2010), dew point and wind from GSOD (Murree, completed by quantile-mapped ERA5-Land) and from Chaklala (Islamabad). Completeness counts months complete after short-gap filling."))
knitr::kable(HOM[station %in% ST_USED, .(station, variable, change_year, class_e5, change_year_tc, class_tc, class)], caption = "Relative homogeneity against two references")
```

# Drought indices (III-C)

SPI used a gamma distribution with the probability of zero precipitation *q* (Eq. 2). SPEI used a three-parameter log-logistic distribution on *W* = P − ET₀ (Eq. 3). Both were fitted with unbiased probability-weighted moments (SPEI package; Beguería et al.). RDIst standardised ln(ΣP/ΣET₀) per calendar month (Eq. 4).
**Every index was calibrated on the common 1985–2014 baseline**, for the observed series and for each model's own simulated series. SRI and SDI were computed from WAPDA gauge discharge (calibrated on 1985–2003, the part of the baseline covered by the gauges; v3) and from GloFAS-ERA5 discharge (1985–2014). Values beyond ±3 (outside the fitted support) were capped at ±3.

```{r index-functions}
IDXCAP <- 3
fix_inf <- function(m) { m[is.infinite(m) & m > 0] <- IDXCAP; m[is.infinite(m) & m < 0] <- -IDXCAP
  m[!is.na(m)] <- pmin(pmax(m[!is.na(m)], -IDXCAP), IDXCAP); m }
std_index <- function(X, k, type, start = c(1981, 1), ref = BASE) {
  X <- as.matrix(X); tsx <- ts(X, start = start, frequency = 12)
  f <- if (type == "spi") SPEI::spi else SPEI::spei
  r <- logw(f(tsx, k, distribution = if (type == "spi") "Gamma" else "log-Logistic",
                          ref.start = c(ref[1], 1), ref.end = c(ref[2], 12), na.rm = TRUE, verbose = FALSE), paste("std_index", type, k))
  out <- matrix(as.numeric(r$fitted), nrow = nrow(X)); fix_inf(out)
}
roll_sum <- function(X, k) apply(as.matrix(X), 2, function(v) as.numeric(stats::filter(v, rep(1, k), sides = 1)))
std_by_month <- function(Y, months, years, ref = BASE) {
  out <- Y
  for (m in 1:12) { i <- months == m; r <- i & years >= ref[1] & years <= ref[2]
    mu <- colMeans(Y[r, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE); sdv <- apply(Y[r, , drop = FALSE], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
    out[i, ] <- sweep(sweep(Y[i, , drop = FALSE], 2, mu), 2, sdv, "/") }
  fix_inf(out)
}
rdi_st <- function(P, PET, k, months, years, ref = BASE) {   # Eq. (4)
  a <- roll_sum(P, k) / roll_sum(PET, k)
  std_by_month(log(pmax(a, 0.01)), months, years, ref)       # alpha floored at 0.01 (k-month totals with zero rain)
}
sdi <- function(Q, k, months, years, ref = BASE) std_by_month(log(pmax(roll_sum(Q, k), 1e-3)), months, years, ref)
all_indices <- function(P, PET, months, years, start = c(1981, 1), ref = BASE, scales = SCALES) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in scales) {
    out[[paste0("SPI", k)]]  <- std_index(P, k, "spi", start, ref)
    out[[paste0("SPEI", k)]] <- std_index(as.matrix(P) - as.matrix(PET), k, "spei", start, ref)
    out[[paste0("RDI", k)]]  <- rdi_st(P, PET, k, months, years, ref)
  }
  out
}
```

```{r write-cf-netcdf}
# v2.1 (audit m10): gridded products archived as CF-1.8 NetCDF on the 0.25° analysis grid (cells outside the domain = missing)
write_cf <- function(file, vars, title) {
  lo <- sort(unique(ANA$lon)); la <- sort(unique(ANA$lat)); il <- match(ANA$lon, lo); ia <- match(ANA$lat, la)
  tdays <- as.numeric(DATES_OBS - as.Date("1981-01-01"))
  dx <- ncdim_def("lon", "degrees_east", lo, longname = "longitude"); dy <- ncdim_def("lat", "degrees_north", la, longname = "latitude")
  dt <- ncdim_def("time", "days since 1981-01-01 00:00:00", tdays, unlim = FALSE, calendar = "standard", longname = "time")
  defs <- lapply(names(vars), function(v) ncvar_def(v, vars[[v]]$units, list(dx, dy, dt), missval = -9999, longname = vars[[v]]$long_name, prec = "float", compression = 4))
  if (file.exists(file)) file.remove(file)
  nc <- nc_create(file, defs, force_v4 = TRUE)
  for (k in seq_along(vars)) { M <- vars[[k]]$data; A3 <- array(NA_real_, c(length(lo), length(la), nrow(M)))
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(M))) A3[il[j], ia[j], ] <- M[, j]
    ncvar_put(nc, defs[[k]], A3)
    for (a in setdiff(names(vars[[k]]), c("data", "units", "long_name"))) ncatt_put(nc, defs[[k]], a, vars[[k]][[a]]) }
  ncatt_put(nc, "lon", "standard_name", "longitude"); ncatt_put(nc, "lat", "standard_name", "latitude"); ncatt_put(nc, "time", "standard_name", "time")
  ncatt_put(nc, "lon", "axis", "X"); ncatt_put(nc, "lat", "axis", "Y"); ncatt_put(nc, "time", "axis", "T")
  for (g in list(c("Conventions", "CF-1.8"), c("title", title), c("institution", "Paper 6 (Potohar Plateau CMIP6 drought), analysis pipeline v2.1"),
                 c("source", "Potohar_Drought_Analysis.Rmd; CHIRPS v2.0 precipitation; ERA5-Land (GEE MONTHLY_AGGR/HOURLY/DAILY_AGGR) Penman-Monteith inputs"),
                 c("history", paste(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "written by Potohar_Drought_Analysis.Rmd")),
                 c("references", "Allen et al. (1998) FAO-56; McKee et al. (1993); Vicente-Serrano et al. (2010); Tsakiris et al. (2007)"),
                 c("grid", "NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 native 0.25-degree grid; cells intersecting the four districts, ICT or the Soan basin")))
    ncatt_put(nc, 0, g[1], g[2])
  nc_close(nc); invisible(file)
}
write_cf(file.path(ROOT, "03_et0", "et0_monthly_0p25_1981_2024.nc"),
         list(et0_pm = list(data = OBS$pm_et0, units = "mm month-1", long_name = "FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration (ERA5-Land inputs)",
                            standard_name = "water_potential_evaporation_amount", cell_methods = "time: sum"),
```

## Hydrological drought: SRI and SDI from WAPDA gauges and GloFAS-ERA5

**v3: WAPDA (SWHP) daily discharge** supplied by the author is the primary hydrological input: Soan at Dhok Pathan (1964–2003), Soan at Chirah (1962–2003) and Sil River near Chahan (1962–2003), parsed from the WAPDA yearbook sheets (m³ s⁻¹) by `scripts/05_read_pmd_wapda.R`. The gauge record ends in 2003, so gauge SRI and SDI are **calibrated on 1985–2003**, the part of the common 1985–2014 baseline that the gauges cover (and after Simly Dam, 1983, upstream of Chirah); 1974–2003 is a sensitivity (DEVIATIONS D23).
GloFAS-ERA5 v4.0 daily discharge (1979–2024, CEMS EWDS, `01h_glofas_ewds.py`) at the cells matching the delineated outlets is **validated against the gauges** (1979–2003) and kept as the record that extends hydrological drought to 2024, calibrated on 1985–2014. The v1 GloFAS calibration on 1997–2024 is kept as a sensitivity (item 7b).

```{r sri}
EWDS <- file.path(OBSF, "glofas_ewds_discharge_daily.csv")    # v2: GloFAS-ERA5 v4.0 historical 1979-2024 from CEMS EWDS
GQ <- fread(if (file.exists(EWDS)) EWDS else file.path(OBSF, "glofas_discharge_daily.csv"))
GLOFAS_SRC <- if (file.exists(EWDS)) "GloFAS-ERA5 v4.0 consolidated (CEMS EWDS), 1979–2024" else "GloFAS v4 via Open-Meteo (from 1997)"
GQ[, date := as.IDate(date)]
QM <- GQ[, .(Q_dp = mean(`Dhok Pathan`, na.rm = TRUE), Q_ch = mean(Chirah, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(year = year(date), month = month(date))]
Q0 <- max(1981, QM[!is.na(Q_dp), min(year)]); QREF <- if (Q0 <= BASE[1]) BASE else c(1997, 2024)
QREF_ALT <- c(1997, 2024)                                       # v2 item 7b: shorter baseline used in v1
QM <- QM[year >= Q0 & year <= 2024][order(year, month)]
SRI <- list(); SDI <- list(); SRI_ALT <- list(); SDI_ALT <- list()
for (k in 1:12) {
  SRI[[k]] <- std_index(cbind(QM$Q_dp, QM$Q_ch), k, "spi", start = c(Q0, 1), ref = QREF)
  SDI[[k]] <- sdi(cbind(QM$Q_dp, QM$Q_ch), k, QM$month, QM$year, ref = QREF)
  SRI_ALT[[k]] <- std_index(cbind(QM$Q_dp, QM$Q_ch), k, "spi", start = c(Q0, 1), ref = QREF_ALT)
  SDI_ALT[[k]] <- sdi(cbind(QM$Q_dp, QM$Q_ch), k, QM$month, QM$year, ref = QREF_ALT)
}
QM[, date := as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-15", year, month))]
KEY$glofas <- list(source = GLOFAS_SRC, start = Q0, ref = QREF)
KEY$glofas_mean_q <- QM[year >= QREF[1] & year <= QREF[2], .(dhok_pathan = mean(Q_dp), chirah = mean(Q_ch))]
if (file.exists(EWDS)) { om <- fread(file.path(OBSF, "glofas_discharge_daily.csv"))[, date := as.IDate(date)]
  j <- merge(GQ, om, by = "date", suffixes = c("_ewds", "_om"))
  KEY$glofas_ewds_vs_openmeteo <- j[, .(r_dp = cor(`Dhok Pathan_ewds`, `Dhok Pathan_om`, use = "complete.obs"), r_ch = cor(Chirah_ewds, Chirah_om, use = "complete.obs"), n_days = .N)] }
# 7b: SDI/SRI drought months with the 1985-2014 vs 1997-2024 calibration (common period 1997-2024)
cp <- QM$year >= 1997
KEY$sdi_baseline_sens <- rbindlist(lapply(c(1, 3, 12), function(k) data.table(k = k,
  r_SRI = cor(SRI[[k]][cp, 1], SRI_ALT[[k]][cp, 1], use = "complete.obs"), r_SDI = cor(SDI[[k]][cp, 1], SDI_ALT[[k]][cp, 1], use = "complete.obs"),
  SRI_drought_pct_main = 100 * mean(SRI[[k]][cp, 1] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE), SRI_drought_pct_alt = 100 * mean(SRI_ALT[[k]][cp, 1] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE))))
KEY$glofas_cells <- fread(file.path(OBSF, "glofas_cell_choice.csv"))[chosen == TRUE]
cat("GloFAS source:", GLOFAS_SRC, "| calibration", QREF, "| mean discharge (m3/s): Dhok Pathan", KEY$glofas_mean_q$dhok_pathan, "; Chirah", KEY$glofas_mean_q$chirah, "\n")
cat("Correlation SRI-3 vs SDI-3 (Dhok Pathan):", round(cor(SRI[[3]][, 1], SDI[[3]][, 1], use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")

# ---------------- v3: WAPDA gauge discharge (primary observed SRI/SDI) ----------------
WQ <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "wapda", "wapda_discharge_daily.csv"))[, date := as.IDate(date)]
GAUGES <- c(dp = "Dhok Pathan", ch = "Chirah", sil = "Sil (Chahan)")
WM <- dcast(WQ[, .(q = if (sum(!is.na(q_m3s)) >= 0.9 * .N) mean(q_m3s, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_), by = .(gauge, year = year(date), month = month(date))],
            year + month ~ gauge, value.var = "q")
setnames(WM, GAUGES, names(GAUGES)); WM <- WM[year >= 1964][order(year, month)]      # 1964: first year of the Dhok Pathan record
QREF_G <- c(1985, 2003); QREF_G_ALT <- c(1974, 2003)
QG <- as.matrix(WM[, names(GAUGES), with = FALSE])
SRI_G <- list(); SDI_G <- list(); SRI_G_ALT <- list()
for (k in 1:12) {
  SRI_G[[k]] <- std_index(QG, k, "spi", start = c(1964, 1), ref = QREF_G)
  SDI_G[[k]] <- sdi(QG, k, WM$month, WM$year, ref = QREF_G)
  SRI_G_ALT[[k]] <- std_index(QG, k, "spi", start = c(1964, 1), ref = QREF_G_ALT)
}
WM[, ym := year * 12L + month]; QM[, ym := year * 12L + month]
KEY$wapda <- list(gauges = unname(GAUGES), records = fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "wapda", "wapda_qc_log.csv"))[, .(gauge, first = as.character(first), last = as.character(last), n_missing)],
                  ref = QREF_G, ref_alt = QREF_G_ALT,
                  mean_q_ref = WM[year %between% QREF_G, lapply(.SD, function(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = names(GAUGES)])
# homogeneity of annual mean flow (Pettitt), 1964-2003
WA <- WM[, lapply(.SD, function(v) if (sum(!is.na(v)) == 12) mean(v) else NA_real_), by = year, .SDcols = names(GAUGES)]
KEY$wapda_pettitt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(GAUGES), function(g) { v <- WA[[g]]; ok <- !is.na(v); p <- trend::pettitt.test(v[ok])
  data.table(gauge = GAUGES[[g]], n_years = sum(ok), p = as.numeric(p$p.value), change_year = WA$year[ok][as.integer(p$estimate)],
             mean_before = mean(v[ok][seq_len(as.integer(p$estimate))]), mean_after = mean(v[ok][-seq_len(as.integer(p$estimate))])) }))
# SRI-3 drought share and SRI-3 / SDI-3 agreement at the gauges
KEY$wapda_sri3 <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(GAUGES), function(j) { i <- WM$year %between% QREF_G
  data.table(gauge = GAUGES[[j]], drought_pct_ref = 100 * mean(SRI_G[[3]][i, j] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE),
             drought_pct_1981_2003_altref = 100 * mean(SRI_G_ALT[[3]][WM$year >= 1981, j] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE),
             drought_pct_1981_2003 = 100 * mean(SRI_G[[3]][WM$year >= 1981, j] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE),
             r_SRI3_SDI3 = cor(SRI_G[[3]][, j], SDI_G[[3]][, j], use = "complete.obs"), r_SRI3_main_vs_alt = cor(SRI_G[[3]][, j], SRI_G_ALT[[3]][, j], use = "complete.obs")) }))
# GloFAS-ERA5 vs gauge: monthly discharge (1979-2003) and SRI-3 (1985-2003; each with its own calibration)
kge1 <- function(s, o) { r <- cor(s, o); c(r = r, KGE = 1 - sqrt((r - 1)^2 + (sd(s) / sd(o) - 1)^2 + (mean(s) / mean(o) - 1)^2)) }
GVAL <- rbindlist(lapply(c(dp = "Q_dp", ch = "Q_ch"), function(gc) {
  g <- names(which(c(dp = "Q_dp", ch = "Q_ch") == gc)); j <- merge(QM[, .(ym, year, s = get(gc))], WM[, .(ym, o = get(g))], by = "ym")[!is.na(o) & !is.na(s)]
  sj <- merge(data.table(ym = QM$ym, s = SRI[[3]][, match(g, c("dp", "ch"))]), data.table(ym = WM$ym, o = SRI_G[[3]][, match(g, names(GAUGES))]), by = "ym")[
    (ym - 1) %/% 12 >= QREF_G[1] & (ym - 1) %/% 12 <= QREF_G[2] & !is.na(s) & !is.na(o)]
  A <- sj$s <= THR; B <- sj$o <= THR
  data.table(gauge = GAUGES[[g]], period_Q = paste(range(j$year), collapse = "–"), n_months = nrow(j), mean_gauge = mean(j$o), mean_GloFAS = mean(j$s),
             bias_pct = 100 * (mean(j$s) / mean(j$o) - 1), r_Q = kge1(j$s, j$o)[["r"]], r_logQ = cor(log(j$s), log(pmax(j$o, 1e-3))), KGE = kge1(j$s, j$o)[["KGE"]],
             r_SRI3 = cor(sj$s, sj$o), POD_SRI3 = sum(A & B) / sum(B), CSI_SRI3 = sum(A & B) / sum(A | B))
}))
KEY$glofas_vs_wapda <- GVAL
fwrite(GVAL, file.path(ROOT, "11_validation_uncertainty", "glofas_vs_wapda_gauges.csv"))
fwrite(cbind(WM[, .(year, month)], setnames(as.data.table(round(SRI_G[[3]], 3)), paste0("SRI3_", names(GAUGES))), setnames(as.data.table(round(SDI_G[[3]], 3)), paste0("SDI3_", names(GAUGES)))),
       file.path(ROOT, "05_characteristics", "wapda_SRI3_SDI3_monthly.csv"))
save_table(GVAL[, .(Gauge = gauge, Period = period_Q, `Gauge mean (m³/s)` = mean_gauge, `GloFAS mean (m³/s)` = mean_GloFAS, `Bias (%)` = bias_pct, `r (Q)` = r_Q,
                    `r (log Q)` = r_logQ, KGE, `r (SRI-3)` = r_SRI3, `POD (SRI-3 ≤ −1)` = POD_SRI3, `CSI (SRI-3 ≤ −1)` = CSI_SRI3)],
           "S7", "GloFAS-ERA5 v4.0 discharge against WAPDA gauges (monthly)", "TableS7_glofas_vs_wapda",
           note = paste0("Gauge SRI-3 calibrated on ", paste(QREF_G, collapse = "–"), ", GloFAS SRI-3 on ", paste(QREF, collapse = "–"), "; SRI-3 scores over ", paste(QREF_G, collapse = "–"), ". Source: SWHP, WAPDA."))
knitr::kable(GVAL, digits = 2, caption = "GloFAS-ERA5 vs WAPDA gauges")
knitr::kable(KEY$wapda_pettitt, digits = 3, caption = "Pettitt test on annual mean discharge at the WAPDA gauges")
```

## Agricultural drought: Vegetation Health Index (MODIS)

VCI = (NDVI − NDVI_min)/(NDVI_max − NDVI_min) and TCI = (LST_max − LST)/(LST_max − LST_min) were computed per pixel and calendar month, with VHI = 0.5·VCI + 0.5·TCI (×100) [37].
The extremes come from the full MODIS record (2000–2024), because the 1985–2014 baseline pre-dates MODIS (DEVIATIONS D10). Regional VHI is the cropland-weighted mean, with weights from the ESA WorldCover 2021 cropland fraction. VHI < 40 marks agricultural drought.

```{r vhi}
HAS_VHI <- file.exists(file.path(OBSF, "modis_monthly_0p01.nc"))
VHI <- if (!HAS_VHI) list(series = data.table(date = as.Date(character()), VHI = numeric(), VCI = numeric(), TCI = numeric())) else cached("vhi", {
  md <- file.path(OBSF, "modis_monthly_0p01.nc")
  nd <- rast(md, subds = "ndvi"); ls <- rast(md, subds = "lst")
  tm <- as.Date(time(nd)); mo <- as.integer(format(tm, "%m"))
  vci <- nd; tci <- ls
  for (m in 1:12) {
    i <- which(mo == m)
    mn <- min(nd[[i]], na.rm = TRUE); mx <- max(nd[[i]], na.rm = TRUE)
    vci[[i]] <- (nd[[i]] - mn) / (mx - mn)
    ln <- min(ls[[i]], na.rm = TRUE); lx <- max(ls[[i]], na.rm = TRUE)
    tci[[i]] <- (lx - ls[[i]]) / (lx - ln)
  }
  vhi <- 100 * (0.5 * vci + 0.5 * tci)
  crop <- rast(file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "worldcover_fractions_0p01.tif"))[["cropland"]]
  crop <- resample(crop, vhi[[1]], method = "near")
  regm <- rasterize(vect(region), crop, touches = FALSE) * crop
  w <- values(regm)[, 1]; w[is.na(w)] <- 0
  V <- values(vhi)
  reg <- apply(V, 2, function(v) { ok <- !is.na(v) & w > 0; sum(v[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) })
  list(series = data.table(date = as.Date(format(tm, "%Y-%m-15")), VHI = reg,
                           VCI = apply(values(vci), 2, function(v) { ok <- !is.na(v) & w > 0; 100 * sum(v[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) }),
                           TCI = apply(values(tci), 2, function(v) { ok <- !is.na(v) & w > 0; 100 * sum(v[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) })),
       mean_map = wrap(app(vhi, mean, na.rm = TRUE)), crop = wrap(crop))
})
VH <- VHI$series[date >= as.Date("2000-02-01")]
if (!HAS_VHI) cat("MODIS monthly file not available: VHI skipped.\n")
vhi_spei <- if (!HAS_VHI) data.table() else rbindlist(lapply(SCALES, function(k) {
  s <- data.table(date = DATES_OBS, spei = IDX_REG$grid[[paste0("SPEI", k)]][, 1], spi = IDX_REG$grid[[paste0("SPI", k)]][, 1])
  m <- merge(VH, s, by = "date")
  data.table(scale = k, r_SPEI = cor(m$VHI, m$spei, use = "complete.obs"), r_SPI = cor(m$VHI, m$spi, use = "complete.obs"))
}))
KEY$vhi_drought_months_pct <- 100 * mean(VH$VHI < 40, na.rm = TRUE)
KEY$vhi_spei_cor <- vhi_spei
knitr::kable(vhi_spei, digits = 3, caption = "Correlation of regional cropland VHI with SPEI-k and SPI-k (2000–2024)")
```

## Benchmark of the computed SPEI against SPEIbase

SPEIbase v2.10 [27] was obtained from Google Earth Engine (`CSIC/SPEI/2_10`, 1981–2023). It replaces the v1 CRU-based reproduction (DEVIATIONS D12, v2). SPEIbase is calibrated on its full 1901–2023 record and uses CRU TS precipitation and PET at 0.5°, so it is not expected to match the local CHIRPS/ERA5-Land SPEI exactly; the comparison tests the timing and amplitude of the anomalies.

```{r speibase}
SBF <- file.path(RAW, "gee", "speibase_v2_10_box.nc")     # SPEIbase v2.10 (CSIC/SPEI/2_10, GEE), 0.5 deg
sb_lon <- ncvar_get(nc_open(SBF), "lon"); sb_lat <- ncvar_get(nc_open(SBF), "lat")
sb_grid <- make_grid(sort(sb_lon), sort(sb_lat), 0.5); sb_grid$id <- seq_len(nrow(sb_grid)); sb_grid$w <- frac_in(sb_grid, region)
speibase_reg <- function(k) {          # area-weighted regional mean of SPEIbase over the 4 districts + ICT, matched to DATES_OBS
  m <- nc_mat(SBF, sprintf("spei_%02d", k), st_drop_geometry(sb_grid)[, c("lon", "lat")], lons = round(sb_lon, 3), lats = round(sb_lat, 3))
  w <- sb_grid$w; ok <- w > 0
  v <- as.numeric(m[, ok, drop = FALSE] %*% w[ok] / sum(w[ok]))
  v[match(DATES_OBS, attr(m, "dates"))]
}
BENCH <- rbindlist(lapply(SCALES, function(k) {
  a <- IDX_REG$grid[[paste0("SPEI", k)]][, 1]; b <- speibase_reg(k); ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b)
  data.table(scale = k, reference = "SPEIbase v2.10 (CSIC/SPEI/2_10)", period = paste(range(YR_OBS[ok]), collapse = "–"), n = sum(ok),
             r = cor(a[ok], b[ok]), rmse = sqrt(mean((a[ok] - b[ok])^2)), agree_drought = mean((a[ok] <= -1) == (b[ok] <= -1)),
             r_vs_CRU_reproduction = cor(IDX_REG$cru[[paste0("SPEI", k)]][ok, 1], b[ok], use = "complete.obs"))
}))
KEY$speibase_benchmark <- BENCH
knitr::kable(BENCH, digits = 3, caption = "Computed SPEI (CHIRPS − ERA5-Land PM ET0) vs SPEIbase v2.10 (CSIC/SPEI/2_10), regional; last column: CRU TS 4.10 reproduction vs SPEIbase")
```

# Drought characteristics, index selection and propagation (III-D)

## Index and time scale most related to wheat losses

v2: **official district wheat yields** were digitised (`scripts/04_digitise_yields.R` → `data/yields/district_wheat.csv`). Sources are PBS *Crops Area and Production by Districts* (1984-85 to 2008-09), Bureau of Statistics Punjab (2007-08 to 2019-20) and *Punjab Development Statistics 2024* (2020-21 to 2022-23). The 2023-24 to 2025-26 seasons come from the Crop Reporting Service (CRS) Punjab district-wise historical data and *Final Rabi Estimates* books; for these seasons Murree and Talagang were added back to Rawalpindi and Chakwal (1985 boundaries). The combined series agrees with the CRS district-wise historical series (1990-91 to 2024-25) to within 0.13% (median; r = 0.998). Harvests within the observed period (1985–2024) are used. These Crop Reporting Service figures are the methodology's primary yield source, so they drive the index selection. GDHY (Table II alternative; 0.5°, 1982–2016, area-weighted per district) is reported alongside.
Yields were detrended linearly (relative anomaly) and correlated with every index (SPI, SPEI, RDI), scale (1, 3, 6, 12) and Rabi month (December–April); significance is from the correlation test (p < 0.05).

```{r yields}
gy <- rast(file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "gdhy_wheat_potohar.nc"))
yrs_y <- 1981:2016
gcells <- as.data.table(xyFromCell(gy, 1:ncell(gy))); setnames(gcells, c("lon", "lat"))
gpoly <- make_grid(sort(unique(gcells$lon)), sort(unique(gcells$lat)), 0.5); gpoly$id <- seq_len(nrow(gpoly))
YD <- rbindlist(lapply(dist$district, function(d) {
  w <- frac_in(gpoly, dist[dist$district == d, ])
  vals <- terra::extract(gy, as.matrix(st_drop_geometry(gpoly)[, c("lon", "lat")]))
  vals <- as.matrix(vals)
  yv <- apply(vals, 2, function(v) { ok <- !is.na(v) & w > 0; if (!any(ok)) NA else sum(v[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok]) })
  data.table(district = d, year = yrs_y[seq_along(yv)], yield = yv)
}))
YD <- YD[!is.na(yield)]
YD_GDHY <- YD
OFF <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "yields", "district_wheat.csv"))[flag == "" & !is.na(yield_t_ha) & harvest_year <= max(YR_OBS)]
OFF[, district := fifelse(district == "Islamabad", "Islamabad (ICT)", district)]
YD_OFF <- OFF[, .(district, year = harvest_year, yield = yield_t_ha)]
detr <- function(Y) { Y <- copy(Y); Y[, anom := { f <- fitted(lm(yield ~ year)); (yield - f) / f }, by = district]; Y }
YD_GDHY <- detr(YD_GDHY); YD_OFF <- detr(YD_OFF)
dmap <- setNames(DCOLS, dist$district[match(sub("^w_", "", DCOLS), make.names(dist$district))])
yield_cor <- function(Y) rbindlist(lapply(names(IDX_DIST[[1]]), function(ix) rbindlist(lapply(c(12, 1:4), function(mo) {
  rp <- sapply(dist$district, function(d) {
    v <- IDX_DIST[[dmap[d]]][[ix]][, 1]; s <- data.table(year = YR_OBS, month = MON_OBS, v = v)[month == mo]
    s[, year := if (mo == 12) year + 1L else year]
    m <- merge(Y[district == d], s, by = "year"); if (nrow(m) < 15) return(c(NA, NA))
    ct <- cor.test(m$anom, m$v); c(ct$estimate, ct$p.value)
  })
  data.table(index = ix, month = month.abb[mo], mean_r = mean(rp[1, ], na.rm = TRUE), min_r = min(rp[1, ], na.rm = TRUE),
             n_sig = sum(rp[2, ] < 0.05 & rp[1, ] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
}))))
YC_OFF <- setorder(yield_cor(YD_OFF), -mean_r); YC_GDHY <- setorder(yield_cor(YD_GDHY), -mean_r)
YC <- YC_OFF                                             # primary: official Crop Reporting Service statistics
SEL <- YC[1]; SEL_TYPE <- sub("[0-9]+$", "", SEL$index); SEL_K <- as.integer(sub("^[A-Z]+", "", SEL$index))
SEL_NAME <- paste0(SEL_TYPE, "-", SEL_K)
KEY$selected_index <- list(index = SEL_NAME, month = SEL$month, mean_r = SEL$mean_r, n_sig = SEL$n_sig,
                           source = paste0("official district yields ", paste(range(OFF$harvest_year), collapse = "–")))
KEY$yield_top5 <- YC[1:5]; KEY$yield_top5_gdhy <- YC_GDHY[1:5]
KEY$yield_sel_in_gdhy <- YC_GDHY[index == SEL$index & month == SEL$month]
KEY$yield_off_vs_gdhy_r <- merge(YD_OFF, YD_GDHY, by = c("district", "year"))[, .(r = cor(anom.x, anom.y), n = .N), by = district]
fwrite(YC_OFF, file.path(ROOT, "05_characteristics", "yield_index_correlations_official.csv"))
fwrite(YC_GDHY, file.path(ROOT, "05_characteristics", "yield_index_correlations_gdhy.csv"))
cat("Selected index (official yields):", SEL_NAME, "ending in", SEL$month, "; mean r =", round(SEL$mean_r, 3),
    "| GDHY best:", YC_GDHY$index[1], YC_GDHY$month[1], round(YC_GDHY$mean_r[1], 3), "\n")
knitr::kable(cbind(YC_OFF[1:10, .(official = paste(index, month), r_official = mean_r, sig_official = n_sig)],
                   YC_GDHY[1:10, .(GDHY = paste(index, month), r_GDHY = mean_r, sig_GDHY = n_sig)]), digits = 3,
             caption = paste0("Top correlations of detrended wheat yields with drought indices: official district statistics (",
                              paste(range(OFF$harvest_year), collapse = "–"), ") vs GDHY (1982–2016)"))
```

Groundnut, the main Kharif oilseed of the plateau, was checked against the same indices using the Crop Reporting Service *Final Kharif Estimates* books (district area and production, 2017-18 onwards; `data/yields/district_groundnut.csv`). Only eight seasons fall inside the observed period, so this is a consistency check rather than a selection criterion. Yields of Attock, Chakwal, Jhelum and Rawalpindi (the districts with > 0.5 × 10³ ha) were expressed as relative anomalies from each district's mean and pooled. They were then correlated with each index ending in August–October of the sowing year. SPEI-3 ending in September (July–September monsoon) was fixed in advance as the reference.

```{r groundnut}
GN <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "yields", "district_groundnut.csv"))[!is.na(yield_t_ha) & area_000ha > 0.5]
GN[, sow_year := harvest_year - 1L][, district := fifelse(district == "Islamabad", "Islamabad (ICT)", district)]
GN <- GN[sow_year <= max(YR_OBS)][, anom := yield_t_ha / mean(yield_t_ha) - 1, by = district]
GC <- rbindlist(lapply(c("SPI3", "SPEI1", "SPEI3", "SPEI6", "RDI3"), function(ix) rbindlist(lapply(8:10, function(mo) {
  m <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(GN$district), function(d) {
    s <- data.table(sow_year = YR_OBS, month = MON_OBS, v = IDX_DIST[[dmap[d]]][[ix]][, 1])[month == mo]
    merge(GN[district == d, .(district, sow_year, anom)], s, by = "sow_year") }))
  ct <- cor.test(m$anom, m$v); data.table(index = ix, month = month.abb[mo], r = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = nrow(m))
}))))
setorder(GC, -r)
KEY$groundnut_check <- list(seasons = paste(range(GN$sow_year), collapse = "–"), n = GC$n[1], districts = sort(unique(GN$district)),
                            reference = GC[index == "SPEI3" & month == "Sep"], best = GC[1])
fwrite(GC, file.path(ROOT, "05_characteristics", "groundnut_index_correlations_crs.csv"))
knitr::kable(GC[1:8], digits = 3, caption = "Pooled correlation of groundnut yield anomalies (CRS Punjab) with drought indices ending in August–October of the sowing year")
```

## Run theory (Eq. 5) and trends (TFPW–Mann–Kendall, Sen's slope)

```{r runs}
runs_events <- function(x, dates, thr = THR) {
  b <- !is.na(x) & x <= thr; r <- rle(b); e <- cumsum(r$lengths); s <- e - r$lengths + 1
  k <- which(r$values)
  if (!length(k)) return(data.table(start = as.Date(character()), end = as.Date(character()), D = integer(), S = numeric(), I = numeric(), peak = numeric()))
  data.table(start = dates[s[k]], end = dates[e[k]], D = r$lengths[k],
             S = sapply(k, function(i) sum(abs(x[s[i]:e[i]]))), peak = sapply(k, function(i) min(x[s[i]:e[i]])))[, I := S / D][]
}
char_summary <- function(x, dates, years, per, thr = THR) {
  i <- years >= per[1] & years <= per[2]; ev <- runs_events(x[i], dates[i], thr); ny <- per[2] - per[1] + 1
  data.table(n_events = nrow(ev), events_per_decade = 10 * nrow(ev) / ny, freq_pct = 100 * mean(x[i] <= thr, na.rm = TRUE),
             D_mean = if (nrow(ev)) mean(ev$D) else 0, S_mean = if (nrow(ev)) mean(ev$S) else 0,
             I_mean = if (nrow(ev)) mean(ev$I) else NA_real_, D_max = if (nrow(ev)) max(ev$D) else 0, S_max = if (nrow(ev)) max(ev$S) else 0)
}
EV_OBS <- runs_events(IDX_REG$grid[[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1], DATES_OBS)
fwrite(EV_OBS, file.path(ROOT, "05_characteristics", paste0("events_obs_", SEL_NAME, ".csv")))
CH_OBS <- rbindlist(lapply(names(IDX_REG$grid), function(ix) cbind(index = ix,
  char_summary(IDX_REG$grid[[ix]][, 1], DATES_OBS, YR_OBS, c(1981, 2024)))))
KEY$obs_char <- CH_OBS
KEY$obs_events_sel <- EV_OBS[order(-S)][1:min(5, .N)]
knitr::kable(CH_OBS, digits = 2, caption = "Observed drought characteristics 1981–2024 (run theory, threshold −1)")

tfpw <- function(y) {
  y <- as.numeric(y); ok <- !is.na(y); if (sum(ok) < 10) return(c(Z = NA, p = NA, slope = NA))
  r <- tryCatch(modifiedmk::tfpwmk(y[ok]), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r)) return(c(Z = NA, p = NA, slope = NA))
  c(Z = unname(r["Z-Value"]), p = unname(r["P-value"]), slope = unname(r["Sen's Slope"]))
}
ann <- REG[, .(P = sum(P_chirps), ET0 = sum(ET0_pm), Tmax = mean(Tmax), Tmin = mean(Tmin), WB = sum(P_chirps - ET0_pm)), by = year]
selx <- IDX_REG$grid[[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1]
ann2 <- data.table(year = YR_OBS, month = MON_OBS, sel = selx, spei12 = IDX_REG$grid$SPEI12[, 1], spi12 = IDX_REG$grid$SPI12[, 1],
                   rdi12 = IDX_REG$grid$RDI12[, 1])[, .(SEL_mean = mean(sel, na.rm = TRUE), drought_months = sum(sel <= THR, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                        severity = sum(abs(sel[sel <= THR]), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                        SPEI12_Dec = spei12[month == 12], SPI12_Dec = spi12[month == 12], RDI12_Dec = rdi12[month == 12]), by = year]
ann <- merge(ann, ann2, by = "year")
vars_tr <- c(P = "Annual precipitation (mm/decade)", ET0 = "Annual PM ET0 (mm/decade)", Tmax = "Mean Tmax (°C/decade)",
             Tmin = "Mean Tmin (°C/decade)", WB = "Annual P − ET0 (mm/decade)", SPI12_Dec = "SPI-12, December (per decade)",
             SPEI12_Dec = "SPEI-12, December (per decade)", RDI12_Dec = "RDIst-12, December (per decade)",
             SEL_mean = paste0("Annual mean ", SEL_NAME, " (per decade)"), drought_months = paste0("Drought months, ", SEL_NAME, " ≤ −1 (months/decade)"),
             severity = paste0("Annual severity, ", SEL_NAME, " (per decade)"))
TR <- rbindlist(lapply(names(vars_tr), function(v) { t <- tfpw(ann[[v]]); data.table(Series = "Potohar (gridded, 1981–2024)", Variable = vars_tr[[v]],
                 Z = t["Z"], p = t["p"], `Sen slope` = 10 * t["slope"]) }))
if (HAS_VHI) {
  VHA <- VH[, .(VHI = mean(VHI, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(year = year(date))][year >= 2001]
  t <- tfpw(VHA$VHI); TR <- rbind(TR, data.table(Series = "Potohar cropland (MODIS, 2001–2024)", Variable = "Annual mean VHI (per decade)", Z = t["Z"], p = t["p"], `Sen slope` = 10 * t["slope"]))
}
for (s in ST_USED) {
  a <- STX[[s]]$data[, .(P = if (all(!is.na(P))) sum(P) else NA_real_, ET0 = if (all(!is.na(ET0))) sum(ET0) else NA_real_), by = year]
  for (v in c("P", "ET0")) { t <- tfpw(a[[v]]); hc <- HOM[station == s & variable == v, class]
    TR <- rbind(TR, data.table(Series = paste0(s, " station"), Variable = vars_tr[[v]], Z = t["Z"], p = t["p"], `Sen slope` = 10 * t["slope"],
                               Homogeneity = if (length(hc)) hc else NA_character_), fill = TRUE) }
}
# v2.1 (FDR fix): district-mean trends are the primary trend result; Benjamini-Hochberg across the five units per variable
dname <- setNames(dist$district[match(sub("^w_", "", DCOLS), make.names(dist$district))], DCOLS)
vars_d <- c(P = "Annual precipitation (mm/decade)", ET0 = "Annual PM ET0 (mm/decade)", WB = "Annual P − ET0 (mm/decade)",
            SPEI12_Dec = "SPEI-12, December (per decade)", drought_months = paste0("Drought months, ", SEL_NAME, " ≤ −1 (months/decade)"))
DMEAN <- list()
DTR <- rbindlist(lapply(DCOLS, function(d) {
  a <- data.table(year = YR_OBS, P = wmean(OBS$chirps_pr, ANA[[d]]), E = wmean(OBS$pm_et0, ANA[[d]]), s12 = IDX_DIST[[d]]$SPEI12[, 1],
                  sel = IDX_DIST[[d]][[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1], mo = MON_OBS)[, .(P = sum(P), ET0 = sum(E), WB = sum(P - E), SPEI12_Dec = s12[mo == 12],
                                                                                 drought_months = sum(sel <= THR, na.rm = TRUE)), by = year]
  DMEAN[[d]] <<- a[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = names(vars_d)]
  rbindlist(lapply(names(vars_d), function(v) { t <- tfpw(a[[v]]); data.table(Series = paste0(dname[[d]], " (district mean)"), Variable = vars_d[[v]], var_key = v, unit_key = d,
                                                                            Z = t["Z"], p = t["p"], `Sen slope` = 10 * t["slope"]) })) }))
DTR[, p_BH := p.adjust(p, "BH"), by = Variable]
KEY$district_trends <- DTR
KEY$district_means_1981_2024 <- lapply(setNames(names(vars_d), names(vars_d)), function(v) sapply(DMEAN, function(x) x[[v]]))
TR <- rbind(DTR, TR, fill = TRUE)
TR[is.na(Homogeneity), Homogeneity := "—"]
TR[, Signif := fifelse(!is.na(p_BH), fifelse(p_BH < 0.05, "*", ""), fifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))]
TR[Homogeneity %in% c("suspect", "doubtful"), Signif := paste0(Signif, " (not interpreted: inhomogeneous)")]
KEY$trends <- TR
# v2 item 1b: trend audit (TFPW-MK p-values and the arithmetic behind "ET0 offsets x% of the rainfall increase")
tP <- tfpw(ann$P); tE <- tfpw(ann$ET0); tW <- tfpw(ann$WB)
KEY$trend_audit <- list(P_slope_mm_dec = 10 * tP[["slope"]], P_p = tP[["p"]], ET0_slope_mm_dec = 10 * tE[["slope"]], ET0_p = tE[["p"]],
                        WB_slope_mm_dec = 10 * tW[["slope"]], WB_p = tW[["p"]],
                        offset_pct = 100 * tE[["slope"]] / tP[["slope"]],
                        P_minus_ET0_slopes = 10 * (tP[["slope"]] - tE[["slope"]]),
                        note = "offset = Sen slope(ET0) / Sen slope(P); Sen slopes are not additive, so P - ET0 slopes differs slightly from the WB slope")
save_table(TR, 2, "Trend results (TFPW–Mann–Kendall test and Sen's slope)", "Table2_trends",
           note = "District means (primary): * significant after Benjamini–Hochberg control across the five units for each variable (p_BH < 0.05). Regional and station series: * p < 0.05. Slopes are per decade. Gridded series: CHIRPS precipitation and FAO-56 PM ET0 from ERA5-Land inputs, area-weighted (exact polygon fractions).", digits = 3)
```

```{r fine-trends}
FINE <- cached("fine_trends", {
  f <- file.path(OBSF, "obs_monthly_fine005.nc")
  nc <- nc_open(f); lo <- ncvar_get(nc, "lon"); la <- ncvar_get(nc, "lat"); nc_close(nc)
  FG <- CJ(lat = round(la, 3), lon = round(lo, 3))
  M <- list(pr = nc_mat(f, "pr", FG, lons = round(lo, 3), lats = round(la, 3)))
  ef <- file.path(RAW, "gee", "era5land_pm_inputs_005.nc")                       # ERA5-Land PM inputs (primary)
  e5 <- lapply(c(tx = "temperature_2m_max", tn = "temperature_2m_min", td = "dewpoint_temperature_2m",
                 rs = "surface_solar_radiation_downwards_sum", ws = "wind_speed_10m"), function(v) nc_mat(ef, v, FG, lons = round(lo, 3), lats = round(la, 3)))
  M$tasmax <- e5$tx - 273.15; M$tasmin <- e5$tn - 273.15; M$vap <- e0(e5$td - 273.15)
  M$rsds <- e5$rs / matrix(days_in_month(DATES_OBS), length(DATES_OBS), ncol(e5$rs)) / 1e6; M$sfcWind <- e5$ws
  zf <- terra::extract(dem90, cbind(FG$lon, FG$lat))[, 1]
  ok <- colSums(!is.na(M$pr)) > 400 & colSums(!is.na(M$tasmax)) > 400
  FG <- FG[ok]; M <- lapply(M, function(m) m[, ok]); zf <- zf[ok]
  et <- pm_monthly(M$tasmax, M$tasmin, M$rsds, M$sfcWind, M$vap, zf, FG$lat, MON_OBS, days_in_month(DATES_OBS))
  sp12 <- std_index(M$pr - et, 12, "spei")
  yrs <- unique(YR_OBS)
  aP <- rowsum(M$pr, YR_OBS); aE <- rowsum(et, YR_OBS); aS <- sp12[MON_OBS == 12, ]
  trm <- function(A) t(apply(A, 2, tfpw))
  list(grid = FG, P = trm(aP), ET0 = trm(aE), SPEI12 = trm(aS), meanP = colMeans(aP), meanE = colMeans(aE))
})
```

```{r fig2, fig.height=6.4}
  d <- data.table(FINE$grid, slope = 10 * TRM[, "slope"], p = p.adjust(TRM[, "p"], "BH"))   # v2.1: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (Wilks 2016)

}
```

## Propagation from meteorological to hydrological drought

The propagation lag is the lag of maximum cross-correlation between catchment-mean SPEI-*k* (k = 1–12) and SRI-1, as in [5]: the Soan basin to Dhok Pathan for Dhok Pathan and the delineated Chirah catchment for Chirah (v3.1). The Sil gauge near Chahan has no location in the WAPDA file, so its catchment cannot be defined and it is used for SRI/SDI only. Correlations were evaluated at lags of 0–6 months. **v3:** the primary estimate uses the WAPDA gauge SRI-1 (1981–2003, the overlap of the gauge record with the observed SPEI); GloFAS-ERA5 SRI-1 gives the same analysis for the same years and for 1985–2024.

# GCM evaluation and bias correction (III-E)

## Evaluation of the 27 NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 models, 1985–2014 (Eq. 6)

Each model's raw NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 output was evaluated against the gridded observations: CHIRPS for P, and ERA5-Land for Tmax, Tmin and PM ET₀ (the dataset that also provides the QDM targets). It was also evaluated against the station climatologies. The metrics were:
- Kling–Gupta efficiency (KGE = 1 − √[(r−1)² + (α−1)² + (β−1)²]) on the space–time monthly climatology;
- the spatial pattern correlation of the annual-mean field;
- the RMSD normalised by the observed standard deviation;
- the station KGE of the annual cycle at the station cells.

Models were ranked by **compromise programming** (v2.2 Item 4, PREREGISTRATION.md). Every criterion is normalised as d = (x − best)/(worst − best), and the distance from the ideal point is L = √(Σ w d² / Σ w), with **entropy weights** w (CRITIC and equal weights are sensitivities). A model with negative KGE for any variable (no skill relative to the observed mean) was ranked last and kept out of the normalisation, so that a single failed model cannot compress the range of a criterion. Rank stability was assessed with a **moving-block bootstrap** over 1985–2014: 1000 replicates of six 5-year blocks, with the same years for observations, stations and models, and every metric, weight and rank recomputed. The ten models with the highest probability of a top-10 rank, P(top 10), were retained (ties by mean rank), with weights ∝ 1/L. The selection was frozen (06_gcm_eval/selection_frozen.csv) before any projection was computed.

```{r gcm-read}
MODELS <- names(cfg$models)
GCMF <- file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "gcm_monthly")
VARS6 <- c("pr", "tasmax", "tasmin", "hurs", "rsds", "sfcWind")
fill_missing_years <- function(M, months) {   # isolated missing values: mean of the same month in adjacent years
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(M))) { bad <- which(is.na(M[, j]))
    for (i in bad) { nb <- c(i - 12, i + 12, i - 24, i + 24); nb <- nb[nb >= 1 & nb <= nrow(M)]
      M[i, j] <- mean(M[nb, j], na.rm = TRUE) } }
  M
}
read_gcm_exp <- function(m, e) {
    f <- file.path(GCMF, paste0(m, "_", e, ".nc")); if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    x <- setNames(lapply(VARS6, function(v) nc_mat(f, v, ANA)), VARS6)
    d <- attr(x$pr, "dates"); mo <- as.integer(format(d, "%m"))
    nmiss <- sapply(x, function(a) sum(is.na(a)))
    x <- lapply(x, function(a) { if (anyNA(a)) a <- fill_missing_years(a, mo); attr(a, "dates") <- d; a })
    attr(x, "n_filled") <- nmiss; x
}
GCM_AVAIL <- MODELS[file.exists(file.path(GCMF, paste0(MODELS, "_historical.nc")))]
if (length(GCM_AVAIL) < length(MODELS)) cat("Historical files missing for:", setdiff(MODELS, GCM_AVAIL), "\n")
GCM <- cached(paste0("gcm_hist_", length(GCM_AVAIL)), sapply(GCM_AVAIL, function(m) list(historical = read_gcm_exp(m, "historical")), simplify = FALSE))
MODELS <- GCM_AVAIL
D_H <- attr(GCM[[1]]$historical$pr, "dates")
MON_H <- as.integer(format(D_H, "%m")); YR_H <- as.integer(format(D_H, "%Y"))
D_F <- seq(as.Date("2015-01-15"), as.Date("2100-12-15"), by = "month")
MON_F <- as.integer(format(D_F, "%m")); YR_F <- as.integer(format(D_F, "%Y"))
ea_from_hurs <- function(h, tx, tn) h / 100 * (e0(tx) + e0(tn)) / 2
gcm_et0 <- function(x, months, method = "pm", ndays = std_days(months)) {
  if (method == "pm") pm_monthly(x$tasmax, x$tasmin, x$rsds, x$sfcWind, ea_from_hurs(x$hurs, x$tasmax, x$tasmin), ANA$z, ANA$lat, months, ndays)
  else hg_monthly(x$tasmax, x$tasmin, ANA$lat, months, ndays)
}
```

## Audit of wind, radiation and ET₀ against stations (v2 item 1a)

Unit and height checks were made in the code. GSOD WDSP is converted from knots to m s⁻¹ (×0.514444). NEX-GDDP `sfcWind`, ERA5-Land and TerraClimate winds are all **10 m** speeds, so like is compared with like. Every PM calculation converts 10 m wind to 2 m with FAO-56 Eq. 47 (u₂ = 0.748·u₁₀) inside `pm_monthly()`/`fao56_pm()`. NEX-GDDP `rsds` is converted from W m⁻² to MJ m⁻² d⁻¹ (×0.0864) and ERA5-Land from J m⁻² month⁻¹ (÷days÷10⁶).

```{r audit-wind-rad}
# grid cell of each station on the full 0.25 deg download grid (stations outside the box are skipped)
```
