```{r gcm-eval}
clim12 <- function(M, months, years, per = BASE) { i <- years >= per[1] & years <= per[2]
  t(sapply(1:12, function(m) colMeans(M[i & months == m, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))) }
REGC <- ANA$w_region > 0
kge <- function(s, o) { r <- cor(s, o); a <- sd(s) / sd(o); b <- mean(s) / mean(o)
  c(KGE = 1 - sqrt((r - 1)^2 + (a - 1)^2 + (b - 1)^2), r = r, alpha = a, beta = b) }
OBS_CLIM <- list(pr = clim12(OBS$chirps_pr, MON_OBS, YR_OBS), tasmax = clim12(OBS$e5_tasmax, MON_OBS, YR_OBS),   # v2.1: ERA5-Land (Table I; QDM target)
                 tasmin = clim12(OBS$e5_tasmin, MON_OBS, YR_OBS), ET0 = clim12(OBS$pm_et0, MON_OBS, YR_OBS))
source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "R", "ranking_helpers.R"))   # station_kge (v3.1), crit_weights, cp_rank, eval_from_counts
# station climatologies (annual cycle); st_cells, ST_EVAL and ST_EVAL_V (eligible stations per variable) are set in stations-monthly
st_clim <- lapply(setNames(ST_EVAL, ST_EVAL), function(s) STX[[s]]$data[year >= BASE[1] & year <= BASE[2],
  .(pr = mean(P, na.rm = TRUE), tasmax = mean(Tmax, na.rm = TRUE), tasmin = mean(Tmin, na.rm = TRUE), ET0 = mean(ET0, na.rm = TRUE)), by = month][order(month)])
EVAL <- cached("gcm_eval_v2_1", rbindlist(lapply(MODELS, function(m) {
  x <- GCM[[m]]$historical; et <- gcm_et0(x, MON_H, ndays = days_in_month(D_H))
  sim <- list(pr = clim12(x$pr, MON_H, YR_H), tasmax = clim12(x$tasmax, MON_H, YR_H), tasmin = clim12(x$tasmin, MON_H, YR_H), ET0 = clim12(et, MON_H, YR_H))
  rbindlist(lapply(names(sim), function(v) {
    s <- sim[[v]][, REGC]; o <- OBS_CLIM[[v]][, REGC]
    k <- kge(as.numeric(s), as.numeric(o))
    pcc <- cor(colMeans(s), colMeans(o))
    nrmsd <- sqrt(mean((s - o)^2)) / sd(as.numeric(o))
    kst <- station_kge(sim[[v]], function(st) st_clim[[st]][[v]], ST_EVAL_V[[v]], st_cells)   # one value per cell (v3.1)
    data.table(model = m, variable = v, KGE = k["KGE"], r = k["r"], alpha = k["alpha"], beta = k["beta"], PCC = pcc, nRMSD = nrmsd, KGE_station = kst)
  }))
})))
# ---- v2.2 Item 4 (PREREGISTRATION.md): entropy-weighted compromise programming and block-bootstrap rank stability ----
# d = (x - best)/(worst - best) per criterion (16 criteria), best/worst over models that pass the KGE >= 0 screen (D17).
# Criterion weights: entropy (primary), CRITIC and equal (sensitivities). L = sqrt(sum w d^2 / sum w). No-skill models rank last.
source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "R", "ranking_helpers.R"))   # crit_weights, cp_rank, eval_from_counts
crit <- cp_criteria(EVAL)
NOSKILL <- EVAL[KGE < 0, unique(model)]
KEY$no_skill_models <- NOSKILL
FULL <- lapply(c(entropy = "entropy", critic = "critic", equal = "equal"), function(w) cp_rank(EVAL, w))
KEY$criterion_weights <- rbindlist(lapply(names(FULL), function(w) data.table(weighting = w, criterion = names(FULL[[w]]$weights), weight = FULL[[w]]$weights)))
# moving-block bootstrap over 1985-2014: 6 blocks of 5 years (starts uniform on 1985-2010), same years for obs, stations and models
BYRS <- BASE[1]:BASE[2]; NBOOT <- 1000L; KEY$n_boot <- NBOOT
set.seed(SEED); BOOT_YEARS <- replicate(NBOOT, { st <- sample(BASE[1]:(BASE[2] - 4), 6, replace = TRUE); as.vector(sapply(st, function(a) a:(a + 4))) })
BOOT_COUNTS <- apply(BOOT_YEARS, 2, function(y) tabulate(match(y, BYRS), length(BYRS)))          # [30 years x NBOOT]
EVSTACK <- cached("gcm_eval_stacks", eval_stacks())                                               # per-year monthly fields (obs, stations, models)
chk <- eval_from_counts(EVSTACK, rep(1, length(BYRS)))                                             # all years once = full sample
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.matrix(chk[order(model, variable), .(KGE, PCC, nRMSD, KGE_station)]), as.matrix(EVAL[order(model, variable), .(KGE, PCC, nRMSD, KGE_station)]), tolerance = 1e-8, check.attributes = FALSE)))
BOOT <- cached("gcm_rank_bootstrap", rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(NBOOT), function(b) { ev <- eval_from_counts(EVSTACK, BOOT_COUNTS[, b])
  rbindlist(lapply(c("entropy", "critic", "equal"), function(w) cbind(rep = b, weighting = w, cp_rank(ev, w)$rank[, .(model, L, rank)]))) })))
NKEEP <- min(cfg$ensemble$keep_top, length(MODELS))
STAB <- BOOT[, .(mean_rank = mean(rank), rank_q05 = quantile(rank, 0.05, type = 7), rank_q95 = quantile(rank, 0.95, type = 7), p_top10 = mean(rank <= NKEEP)), by = .(weighting, model)]
STAB <- merge(STAB, rbindlist(lapply(names(FULL), function(w) cbind(weighting = w, FULL[[w]]$rank[, .(model, L_full = L, rank_full = rank)]))), by = c("weighting", "model"))
setorder(STAB, weighting, -p_top10, mean_rank); STAB[, sel_order := seq_len(.N), by = weighting][, selected := sel_order <= NKEEP]
KEY$rank_stability <- STAB
fwrite(STAB, file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "gcm_rank_bootstrap_stability.csv"))
# selection rule (fixed): 10 highest P(top 10), ties by lower mean rank; entropy weighting is primary
CP <- STAB[weighting == "entropy", .(model, L = L_full, rank_full, mean_rank, rank_q05, rank_q95, p_top10, rank = sel_order)]
CP <- merge(CP, FULL$equal$rank[, .(model, L2 = L)], by = "model")[order(rank)]                    # L2: equal weights (v2.1 definition)
TOP <- CP[rank <= NKEEP, model]
CP[, weight := fifelse(rank <= NKEEP, (1 / L) / sum((1 / L)[rank <= NKEEP]), 0)]
FROZEN <- file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "selection_frozen.csv")
if (file.exists(FROZEN) && !DEV) { fz <- fread(FROZEN)                                             # frozen at tag frozen-bc-rank
  if (!setequal(fz[selected == TRUE, model], TOP)) stop("GCM selection differs from the frozen selection (06_gcm_eval/selection_frozen.csv)")
} else if (!DEV) fwrite(CP[, .(model, selected = rank <= NKEEP, sel_order = rank, p_top10, mean_rank, rank_q05, rank_q95, L_entropy = L, weight)], FROZEN)
V21_SET <- unlist(cfg$ensemble$v21_primary_set)
KEY$selection_overlap <- data.table(comparison = c("v2.1 primary set", "v2 TerraClimate-referenced set", "CRITIC-weighted selection", "equal-weight selection"),
  n_common = c(length(intersect(TOP, V21_SET)), length(intersect(TOP, unlist(cfg$ensemble$sensitivity_set_old))),
               length(intersect(TOP, STAB[weighting == "critic" & selected == TRUE, model])), length(intersect(TOP, STAB[weighting == "equal" & selected == TRUE, model]))),
  dropped = c(paste(setdiff(V21_SET, TOP), collapse = ", "), paste(setdiff(unlist(cfg$ensemble$sensitivity_set_old), TOP), collapse = ", "),
              paste(setdiff(STAB[weighting == "critic" & selected == TRUE, model], TOP), collapse = ", "), paste(setdiff(STAB[weighting == "equal" & selected == TRUE, model], TOP), collapse = ", ")),
  added = c(paste(setdiff(TOP, V21_SET), collapse = ", "), paste(setdiff(TOP, unlist(cfg$ensemble$sensitivity_set_old)), collapse = ", "),
            paste(setdiff(TOP, STAB[weighting == "critic" & selected == TRUE, model]), collapse = ", "), paste(setdiff(TOP, STAB[weighting == "equal" & selected == TRUE, model]), collapse = ", ")))
for (w in c("entropy", "critic", "equal")) for (m in STAB[weighting == w, model]) { x <- STAB[weighting == w & model == m]
  rl <- if (w == "entropy") "primary" else "sensitivity"
  add_variant("4", paste0(w, " weights: ", m), rl, "P(top 10)", x$p_top10); add_variant("4", paste0(w, " weights: ", m), rl, "mean rank", x$mean_rank) }
TSR <- STAB[weighting == "entropy", .(`Selection order` = sel_order, Model = model, `L (entropy, full sample)` = round(L_full, 3), `Full-sample rank` = rank_full,
  `Mean rank` = round(mean_rank, 1), `90% rank interval` = sprintf("%g–%g", rank_q05, rank_q95), `P(top 10)` = round(p_top10, 3), Selected = selected,
  `P(top 10), CRITIC` = round(STAB[weighting == "critic"][match(model, STAB[weighting == "critic", model]), p_top10], 3),
  `P(top 10), equal` = round(STAB[weighting == "equal"][match(model, STAB[weighting == "equal", model]), p_top10], 3))]
save_table(TSR, "S2b", "GCM rank stability: moving-block bootstrap over 1985–2014 (1000 replicates, 5-year blocks)", "TableS2b_GCM_rank_stability",
           note = "Entropy-weighted compromise programming (primary); in each replicate the climatologies, 16 metrics, normalisation, weights and ranks are recomputed. Selection: the ten highest P(top 10), ties by mean rank (pre-registered).", digits = 3)
WTS <- setNames(CP[model %in% TOP]$weight, CP[model %in% TOP]$model)[TOP]
if (!DEV) writeLines(union(TOP, intersect(c("GFDL-ESM4", "IPSL-CM6A-LR", "MPI-ESM1-2-HR", "MRI-ESM2-0", "UKESM1-0-LL"), MODELS)),
           file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "phaseB_models.txt"))   # models whose scenario runs are needed (QDM + ISIMIP comparison)
if (DEV) { avail <- MODELS[sapply(MODELS, function(m) all(file.exists(file.path(GCMF, paste0(m, "_", SCEN, ".nc")))))]
  TOP <- intersect(TOP, avail); WTS <- WTS[TOP] / sum(WTS[TOP]); NKEEP <- length(TOP); cat("DEV MODE: models", TOP, "\n") }
KEY$gcm_rank <- CP; KEY$top_models <- TOP; KEY$top_weights <- WTS
fwrite(EVAL, file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "gcm_metrics.csv")); fwrite(CP, file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "gcm_ranking_compromise_programming.csv"))
T2 <- dcast(EVAL, model ~ variable, value.var = c("KGE", "PCC", "nRMSD", "KGE_station"))

L: compromise-programming distance (p = 2, entropy weights over 16 criteria); rank: selection order by bootstrap P(top 10) (Table S2b). Weights are given to the ten retained models. ## Quantile delta mapping and split-sample validation (Eq. 7)

NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 is already bias-adjusted (BCSD against GMFD), so QDM [41] targets the residual local bias relative to the station-informed gridded observations used here. QDM (MBC package, Cannon et al. 2015) was applied to each model **per variable, per grid cell and per calendar month**, as the methodology specifies: the quantile functions of each calendar month are estimated from that month's 30 calibration values only (v2.2 Item 3, PREREGISTRATION.md). Trace handling for precipitation: trace 0.05 mm month⁻¹, jitter factor 0.01, ratio.max 2, all quantiles. The transforms are:
- pr, rsds and sfcWind: multiplicative;
- tasmax, tasmin and hurs: additive.

Two pooled-window variants are **sensitivities only**: (S1) the month and its two neighbours pooled after each month has been standardised by its own climatology, and (S2) the unstandardised ±1-month pooled window used in v2.1.

The calibration window is 1985–2014, and the future was corrected in three blocks (2015–2040, 2041–2070, 2071–2100). The targets are CHIRPS for P and ERA5-Land for the five Penman–Monteith variables; TerraClimate targets are a sensitivity run.
Validation used a **plain split sample per calendar month** (calibration 1985–1999, validation 2000–2014 and the reverse; all 27 GCMs; regional series formed after cell-level correction) with the pre-registered acceptance criteria — (A) the mean over months of |median monthly bias| after correction is below raw for every variable, and (B) no calendar month has a precipitation |median bias| above 25 % — and, in addition, three schemes:
1. A **detrended split sample**: the linear trend was removed from observations and model, QDM was calibrated on 1985–1999 and applied to 2000–2014 (and the reverse), and the model trend was added back. This avoids penalising the correction for the observed warming between the two halves.
2. **Odd/even-year cross-validation.**
3. A **pseudo-reality test**: each retained GCM serves in turn as "truth" for the others, which tests the corrected 2071–2100 SSP5-8.5 distribution.

The reported metrics are quantile bias, Kolmogorov–Smirnov distance, wet-month frequency bias and drought-frequency bias.

```{r qdm}
ISI_MODELS <- c("GFDL-ESM4", "IPSL-CM6A-LR", "MPI-ESM1-2-HR", "MRI-ESM2-0", "UKESM1-0-LL")
# v2.1 (Phase B): QDM/projections for the primary top 10, the old (TerraClimate-referenced) top 10, the ISIMIP3b GCMs and
# every model with scenario data ("all models" sensitivity)
TOP_OLD <- intersect(unlist(cfg$ensemble$sensitivity_set_old), MODELS)
SCEN_AVAIL <- MODELS[sapply(MODELS, function(m) all(file.exists(file.path(GCMF, paste0(m, "_", SCEN, ".nc")))))]
QDM_MODELS <- sort(union(union(TOP, TOP_OLD), union(intersect(ISI_MODELS, MODELS), SCEN_AVAIL)))   # sorted: independent of the ranking
if (DEV) QDM_MODELS <- TOP
GCMS <- cached("gcm_scen", sapply(QDM_MODELS, function(m) setNames(lapply(SCEN, function(s) read_gcm_exp(m, s)), SCEN), simplify = FALSE))
miss_scen <- names(which(sapply(GCMS, function(z) any(sapply(z, is.null)))))
if (length(miss_scen)) stop("Scenario files missing for: ", paste(miss_scen, collapse = ", "), " (run 01a phase B and 02b first)")
for (m in QDM_MODELS) GCM[[m]][SCEN] <- GCMS[[m]]
# v2.1 (Phase B) source-data fix: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 files with a step between the historical (to 2014) and scenario (from
# 2015) series (scripts/03_check_scenario_discontinuity.R: |robust z| > 5 across models; CNRM-CM6-1 and CNRM-ESM2-1 sfcWind,
# -31 to -34% in one year at NASA). The scenario series is rescaled per cell and calendar month so that its 2015-2034 mean equals
# the model's 1995-2014 mean; changes after 2015-2034 are kept. Sensitivity: Table S6 set without these models.
source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "03_check_scenario_discontinuity.R"), local = new.env())   # writes the check table
DISC <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "06_gcm_eval", "scenario_discontinuity_check.csv"))[flag == TRUE & model %in% QDM_MODELS]
for (k in seq_len(nrow(DISC))) { m <- DISC$model[k]; v <- DISC$variable[k]
  h <- GCM[[m]]$historical[[v]]; ih <- YR_H >= 1995 & YR_H <= 2014; i0 <- YR_F >= 2015 & YR_F <= 2034
  FAC <- sapply(1:12, function(mo) colMeans(h[ih & MON_H == mo, , drop = FALSE]) / colMeans(GCM[[m]]$ssp245[[v]][i0 & MON_F == mo, , drop = FALSE]))   # [cell x month], from SSP2-4.5, same for both SSPs
  for (s in SCEN) { x <- GCM[[m]][[s]][[v]]
    for (mo in 1:12) x[MON_F == mo, ] <- sweep(x[MON_F == mo, , drop = FALSE], 2, FAC[, mo], "*")
    GCM[[m]][[s]][[v]] <- x } }
KEY$discontinuity_factor_mean <- if (nrow(DISC)) DISC[, .(model, variable, change_pct = change)] else NULL
KEY$discontinuity_fix <- DISC
FILLED <- rbindlist(lapply(QDM_MODELS, function(m) rbindlist(lapply(names(GCM[[m]]), function(e)
  data.table(model = m, exp = e, t(attr(GCM[[m]][[e]], "n_filled")))))))[pr + tasmax + tasmin + hurs + rsds + sfcWind > 0]
KEY$gcm_filled_values <- FILLED
if (nrow(FILLED)) knitr::kable(FILLED, caption = "Model values filled from adjacent years (missing at the source)")
TARGET <- list(pr = OBS$chirps_pr, tasmax = OBS$e5_tasmax, tasmin = OBS$e5_tasmin, hurs = OBS$e5_hurs, rsds = OBS$e5_rsds, sfcWind = OBS$e5_sfcWind)
TARGET_TC <- list(pr = OBS$chirps_pr, tasmax = OBS$tc_tasmax, tasmin = OBS$tc_tasmin, hurs = OBS$tc_hurs, rsds = OBS$tc_rsds, sfcWind = OBS$tc_sfcWind)
RATIO <- c(pr = TRUE, tasmax = FALSE, tasmin = FALSE, hurs = FALSE, rsds = TRUE, sfcWind = TRUE)
source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "R", "qdm_helpers.R"))   # qdm1, NB3, QDM_METHODS, mclim, qdm_cell (v2.2 Item 3)
BLOCKS <- list(c(2015, 2040), c(2041, 2070), c(2071, 2100))
run_qdm <- function(models, target, method = "permonth", tag = "") {
  ob <- YR_OBS >= BASE[1] & YR_OBS <= BASE[2]; hb <- YR_H >= BASE[1] & YR_H <= BASE[2]
  sapply(models, function(mdl) {
    logp("QDM", tag, method, mdl); set.seed(model_seed(mdl))
    out <- list(historical = list(), ssp245 = list(), ssp585 = list())
    for (v in VARS6) {
      H <- GCM[[mdl]]$historical[[v]]; Hc <- H
      Fc <- lapply(SCEN, function(s) GCM[[mdl]][[s]][[v]]); names(Fc) <- SCEN
      for (j in seq_len(ncol(H))) {
        cq <- function(x, xm) qdm_cell(target[[v]][ob, j], MON_OBS[ob], H[hb, j], MON_H[hb], x, xm, RATIO[[v]], method)
        Hc[, j] <- cq(H[, j], MON_H)
        for (s in SCEN) for (b in BLOCKS) { ib <- YR_F >= b[1] & YR_F <= b[2]; Fc[[s]][ib, j] <- cq(GCM[[mdl]][[s]][[v]][ib, j], MON_F[ib]) }
      }
      out$historical[[v]] <- Hc; for (s in SCEN) out[[s]][[v]] <- Fc[[s]]
    }
    for (e in names(out)) { out[[e]]$hurs <- pmin(pmax(out[[e]]$hurs, 1), 100)
      bad <- out[[e]]$tasmin > out[[e]]$tasmax - 0.1; out[[e]]$tasmin[bad] <- out[[e]]$tasmax[bad] - 0.1 }
    out
  }, simplify = FALSE)
}
# all runs cover every model with scenario data, so that none depends on the Item 4 selection
model_seed <- function(mdl) SEED + match(mdl, sort(MODELS))                                   # per-model RNG stream
QDMX    <- cached("qdm_corrected_permonth", run_qdm(QDM_MODELS, TARGET, "permonth", "main"))          # PRIMARY: per calendar month
QDMX_S1 <- cached("qdm_corrected_pooled_std", run_qdm(QDM_MODELS, TARGET, "pooled_std", "S1"))       # sensitivity S1: standardised ±1-month window
QDMX_S2 <- cached("qdm_corrected_pooled", run_qdm(QDM_MODELS, TARGET, "pooled", "S2"))               # sensitivity S2: v2.1 ±1-month window
QDMX_TC <- cached("qdm_corrected_tc_permonth", run_qdm(QDM_MODELS, TARGET_TC, "permonth", "terraclimate"))   # sensitivity: TerraClimate PM targets
TOPH <- substr(digest::digest(sort(TOP)), 1, 8)                                                     # cache-key suffix of results that depend on TOP

# ---- QDM validation (v2 item 6): (i) detrended split sample, (ii) odd/even-year cross-validation, (iii) pseudo-reality ----
# Metrics on validation-period values, per cell (every 3rd analysis cell) and calendar month, then averaged:
#   quantile bias (Q10, Q50, Q90; % for multiplicative variables, absolute otherwise), Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance,
#   and for precipitation the wet-month frequency bias (P >= 5 mm month-1; monthly data, so wet MONTHS replace wet days)
#   and the drought-frequency bias (3-month totals within a year below the validation-truth 15.87th percentile of the
#   same end-month, i.e. SPI-3 <= -1; truth frequency is 15.87%).
VCELLS <- seq(1, nrow(ANA), by = 3)
qdm_vec <- function(o, Oy, Om, h, Hy, Hm, x, Xm, cal, ratio, method = QDM_METHODS[["primary"]], ...)   # QDM of x calibrated on cal years
  qdm_cell(o[Oy %in% cal], Om[Oy %in% cal], h[Hy %in% cal], Hm[Hy %in% cal], x, Xm, ratio, method, ...)
detrend <- function(x, y, m, ratio, yrs, t0 = yrs[1]) {                    # trend and climatology fitted on yrs ONLY (calibration
  i <- y %in% yrs; t <- (y + (m - 0.5) / 12) - t0                           # half), so nothing of the validation half leaks in
  cl <- tapply(x[i], m[i], mean)[as.character(m)]
  a <- if (ratio) x / pmax(cl, 1e-6) else x - cl                           # relative (ratio vars) or absolute anomaly
  b <- coef(lm(a[i] ~ t[i]))[2]
  tr <- if (ratio) (1 + b * t) else b * t
  list(x = if (ratio) x / pmax(tr, 0.2) else x - tr, tr = tr)
}
ks_stat2 <- function(a, b) { a <- a[!is.na(a)]; b <- b[!is.na(b)]; z <- sort(unique(c(a, b))); max(abs(ecdf(a)(z) - ecdf(b)(z))) }   # = ks.test()$statistic
vmetrics <- function(tru, sim, m, v) {
  rel <- RATIO[[v]]; qs <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
  qb <- sapply(qs, function(p) mean(sapply(1:12, function(k) { a <- quantile(tru[m == k], p, na.rm = TRUE); b <- quantile(sim[m == k], p, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (rel) 100 * (b - a) / max(a, 0.1) else b - a })))
  ks <- mean(sapply(1:12, function(k) ks_stat2(tru[m == k], sim[m == k])))
  out <- c(q10_bias = qb[1], q50_bias = qb[2], q90_bias = qb[3], KS = ks, wet_bias = NA_real_, drought_bias = NA_real_)
  if (v == "pr") {
    out["wet_bias"] <- 100 * (mean(sim >= 5) - mean(tru >= 5))
    yy <- rep(seq_len(length(tru) / 12), each = 12)
    s3 <- function(z) ave(z, yy, FUN = function(w) as.numeric(stats::filter(w, rep(1, 3), sides = 1)))
    T3 <- s3(tru); S3 <- s3(sim)
    out["drought_bias"] <- 100 * mean(sapply(3:12, function(k) { q <- quantile(T3[m == k], 0.1587, na.rm = TRUE); mean(S3[m == k] < q, na.rm = TRUE) })) - 15.87
  }
  out
}
VAL <- cached(paste0("qdm_validation_v2_2_", TOPH), { set.seed(SEED)   # v2.2: primary per-month QDM
  res <- list(); yb <- BASE[1]:BASE[2]; ob <- YR_OBS %in% yb; hb <- YR_H %in% yb
  for (mdl in TOP) for (v in VARS6) for (j in VCELLS) {
    o <- TARGET[[v]][ob, j]; Oy <- YR_OBS[ob]; Om <- MON_OBS[ob]; h <- GCM[[mdl]]$historical[[v]][hb, j]; Hy <- YR_H[hb]; Hm <- MON_H[hb]
    # (i) detrended split sample, both directions
    for (sp in list(list(cal = 1985:1999, val = 2000:2014, lab = "detrended split (cal 1985–99)"), list(cal = 2000:2014, val = 1985:1999, lab = "detrended split (cal 2000–14)"))) {
      od <- detrend(o, Oy, Om, RATIO[[v]], sp$cal, yb[1]); hd <- detrend(h, Hy, Hm, RATIO[[v]], sp$cal, yb[1])   # v2.1: no leakage
      iv <- Hy %in% sp$val; ov <- Oy %in% sp$val
      cv <- qdm_vec(od$x, Oy, Om, hd$x, Hy, Hm, hd$x[iv], Hm[iv], sp$cal, RATIO[[v]])
      cv <- if (RATIO[[v]]) cv * pmax(hd$tr[iv], 0.2) else cv + hd$tr[iv]                     # add the model trend back
      res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.table(scheme = sp$lab, model = mdl, variable = v, cell = j, stage = c("raw", "QDM"),
                                           rbind(vmetrics(o[ov], h[iv], Hm[iv], v), vmetrics(o[ov], cv, Hm[iv], v)))
    }
    # (ii) odd / even years
    for (sp in list(list(cal = yb[yb %% 2 == 1], val = yb[yb %% 2 == 0], lab = "odd/even (cal odd)"), list(cal = yb[yb %% 2 == 0], val = yb[yb %% 2 == 1], lab = "odd/even (cal even)"))) {
      iv <- Hy %in% sp$val; ov <- Oy %in% sp$val
      cv <- qdm_vec(o, Oy, Om, h, Hy, Hm, h[iv], Hm[iv], sp$cal, RATIO[[v]])
      res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.table(scheme = sp$lab, model = mdl, variable = v, cell = j, stage = c("raw", "QDM"),
                                           rbind(vmetrics(o[ov], h[iv], Hm[iv], v), vmetrics(o[ov], cv, Hm[iv], v)))
    }
  }
  # (iii) pseudo-reality: model T is "truth"; model M (raw) is corrected to T over 1985-2014; corrected 2071-2100 SSP5-8.5 vs T's own 2071-2100
  ff <- YR_F >= 2071 & YR_F <= 2100
  for (tm in TOP) for (mdl in setdiff(TOP, tm)) for (v in VARS6) for (j in VCELLS) {
    o <- GCM[[tm]]$historical[[v]][hb, j]; tru <- GCM[[tm]]$ssp585[[v]][ff, j]
    h <- GCM[[mdl]]$historical[[v]][hb, j]; x <- GCM[[mdl]]$ssp585[[v]][ff, j]
    cv <- qdm_vec(o, YR_H[hb], MON_H[hb], h, YR_H[hb], MON_H[hb], x, MON_F[ff], yb, RATIO[[v]])
    res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.table(scheme = "pseudo-reality (2071–2100, SSP5-8.5)", model = paste(mdl, "→", tm), variable = v, cell = j,
                                         stage = c("raw", "QDM"), rbind(vmetrics(tru, x, MON_F[ff], v), vmetrics(tru, cv, MON_F[ff], v)))
  }
  rbindlist(res)
})
VAL[, scheme_group := sub(" \\(.*", "", scheme)]
fwrite(VAL, file.path(ROOT, "07_bias_correction", "qdm_validation_v2_cells.csv"))
VS <- VAL[, .(q10_abs = mean(abs(q10_bias)), q50_abs = mean(abs(q50_bias)), q90_abs = mean(abs(q90_bias)), KS = mean(KS),
              wet_bias = mean(wet_bias), drought_bias = mean(drought_bias)), by = .(scheme_group, variable, stage)]

           "TableS1_QDM_validation_v2", note = "Mean absolute quantile bias (% for P, Rs, wind; °C or %-points otherwise), mean Kolmogorov–Smirnov distance and P drought-frequency bias (%-points; SPI-3 ≤ −1 equivalent), averaged over the retained models, every third 0.25° cell and calendar months.", digits = 2)

# ---- v2.2 Item 3: plain split sample per calendar month, all GCMs, regional series after cell-level correction ----
# Pre-registered acceptance (cal 1985-1999 -> val 2000-2014): (A) per variable, mean over months of the GCM-mean |median monthly
# bias| is below raw; (B) pr: no month with GCM-mean |median bias| > 25 %. Reading (ii) |GCM-mean signed bias| is reported only.
PSPLIT <- cached("qdm_plain_split_permonth", { res <- list()
  yb <- BASE[1]:BASE[2]; ob <- YR_OBS %in% yb; hb <- YR_H %in% yb; Oy <- YR_OBS[ob]; Om <- MON_OBS[ob]; Hy <- YR_H[hb]; Hm <- MON_H[hb]
  for (mdl in QDM_MODELS) { logp("plain split", mdl); set.seed(model_seed(mdl)); for (v in VARS6) {
    O <- TARGET[[v]][ob, , drop = FALSE]; H <- GCM[[mdl]]$historical[[v]][hb, , drop = FALSE]
    for (sp in list(list(cal = 1985:1999, val = 2000:2014), list(cal = 2000:2014, val = 1985:1999))) {
      iv <- Hy %in% sp$val; ov <- Oy %in% sp$val; oreg <- wmean(O[ov, , drop = FALSE], W_REG); sims <- list(raw = wmean(H[iv, , drop = FALSE], W_REG))
      for (mt in names(QDM_METHODS)) { C <- H[iv, , drop = FALSE]
        for (j in seq_len(ncol(H))) C[, j] <- qdm_vec(O[, j], Oy, Om, H[, j], Hy, Hm, H[iv, j], Hm[iv], sp$cal, RATIO[[v]], QDM_METHODS[[mt]])
        sims[[mt]] <- wmean(C, W_REG) }
      a <- sapply(1:12, function(k) median(oreg[Om[ov] == k]))
      for (st in names(sims)) { b <- sapply(1:12, function(k) median(sims[[st]][Hm[iv] == k]))
        res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.table(model = mdl, variable = v, cal = paste(range(sp$cal), collapse = "–"), stage = st, month = 1:12,
          obs_median = a, sim_median = b, bias = if (RATIO[[v]]) 100 * (b - a) / pmax(a, 0.1) else b - a) } } } }
  rbindlist(res) })
PSPLIT[, stage := factor(stage, levels = c("raw", names(QDM_METHODS)))]
PSM <- PSPLIT[, .(mean_abs = mean(abs(bias)), abs_mean = abs(mean(bias)), signed = mean(bias), n_models = .N), by = .(variable, cal, stage, month)]
fwrite(PSPLIT, file.path(ROOT, "07_bias_correction", "qdm_plain_split_permonth_models.csv")); fwrite(PSM, file.path(ROOT, "07_bias_correction", "qdm_plain_split_permonth.csv"))

ACC[, `:=`(pass_A = A_mean_abs < A_raw, pass_A_ii = A_abs_mean < A_raw_ii, pass_B = if (variable[1] == "pr") max_month <= 25 else NA,
           pass_B_ii = if (variable[1] == "pr") max_month_ii <= 25 else NA), by = .(variable, cal, stage)]

           "TableS1b_QDM_plain_split_permonth", note = "All GCMs with scenario data; validation half = the years not used for calibration. % for P, Rs and wind; °C for Tmax/Tmin; %-points for RH. October is row Oct. Acceptance (pre-registered, cal 1985–1999): (A) mean over months below raw for each variable; (B) no P month above 25 %.", digits = 1)
KEY$qdm_october <- PSM[month == 10]
for (k in seq_len(nrow(ACC))) { a <- ACC[k]; rl <- if (a$stage == "primary") "primary" else if (a$stage == "raw") "reference" else "sensitivity"

  if (a$variable == "pr") add_variant("3", paste0(a$stage, " (cal ", a$cal, ")"), rl, "pr: max month |median bias|", a$max_month) }

BA <- rbindlist(lapply(TOP, function(mdl) rbindlist(lapply(VARS6, function(v) {

  data.table(model = mdl, variable = v, raw = b(r), QDM = b(c2))
}))))

### Why does QDM not reduce the out-of-sample precipitation median bias? (v2.1 diagnostic)

The leak-free detrended split was examined for precipitation with a diagnostic. The QDM configuration used for the projections was **not** changed on the basis of these results, because doing so would tune the correction on the validation half. The diagnostic:

- **Decomposes** the validation-period bias into the shift of the observations between the two halves (non-stationarity) and the shift of the raw model.
- **Separates** the dry season (October–May) from the monsoon (June–September).
- **Varies one QDM setting at a time** against the reference configuration, which is the primary method (Cannon et al. 2015 QDM per calendar month, trace 0.05 mm, jitter 0.01, all quantiles, ratio.max = 2). The settings tested are: the standardised ±1-month pooled window (S1), the unstandardised ±1-month pooled window (S2, v2.1), no ratio clipping (ratio.max = ∞), trace 1 mm and 30 quantiles.
- **Repeats the evaluation against detrended observations**, which isolates the distributional correction from the trend mismatch.

```{r qdm-precip-diagnostics}
medb <- function(tru, sim, m, months = 1:12) sapply(months, function(k) { a <- median(tru[m == k]); 100 * (median(sim[m == k]) - a) / max(a, 0.1) })
PDIAG <- cached(paste0("qdm_precip_diagnostics_v2_2_", TOPH), { set.seed(SEED)
  yb <- BASE[1]:BASE[2]; ob <- YR_OBS %in% yb; hb <- YR_H %in% yb; res <- list()
  VARIANTS <- list(reference = list(), `±1-month pooled, standardised (S1)` = list(method = "pooled_std"), `±1-month pooled (S2, v2.1)` = list(method = "pooled"), `no ratio clipping` = list(ratio.max = Inf),
                   `trace 1 mm` = list(trace = 1), `30 quantiles` = list(n.tau = 30))
  for (mdl in TOP) for (j in seq(1, nrow(ANA), by = 3)) {
    o <- TARGET$pr[ob, j]; Oy <- YR_OBS[ob]; Om <- MON_OBS[ob]; h <- GCM[[mdl]]$historical$pr[hb, j]; Hy <- YR_H[hb]; Hm <- MON_H[hb]
    for (sp in list(list(cal = 1985:1999, val = 2000:2014), list(cal = 2000:2014, val = 1985:1999))) {
      iv <- Hy %in% sp$val; ov <- Oy %in% sp$val; ic <- Hy %in% sp$cal; oc_ <- Oy %in% sp$cal
      od <- detrend(o, Oy, Om, TRUE, sp$cal, yb[1]); hd <- detrend(h, Hy, Hm, TRUE, sp$cal, yb[1])
      base <- data.table(model = mdl, cell = j, cal = paste(range(sp$cal), collapse = "–"), month = 1:12,
                         obs_shift = medb(o[oc_], o[ov], Om[ov]),                       # median(obs val) vs median(obs cal), %
                         mod_shift = medb(h[ic], h[iv], Hm[iv]),                         # median(model val) vs median(model cal), %
                         raw = medb(o[ov], h[iv], Hm[iv]))
      for (vn in names(VARIANTS)) { a <- VARIANTS[[vn]]
        cv <- do.call(qdm_vec, c(list(od$x, Oy, Om, hd$x, Hy, Hm, hd$x[iv], Hm[iv], sp$cal, TRUE), a))
        base[[vn]] <- medb(o[ov], cv * pmax(hd$tr[iv], 0.2), Hm[iv])                 # evaluation as in Table S1 (raw obs, model trend added)
        if (vn == "reference") base[["reference, detrended target"]] <- medb(od$x[ov], cv, Hm[iv]) }   # obs and model both detrended
      res[[length(res) + 1]] <- base } }
  rbindlist(res) })
PDIAG[, season := fifelse(month %in% 6:9, "monsoon (Jun–Sep)", "dry season (Oct–May)")]
vcols <- c("raw", "reference", "±1-month pooled, standardised (S1)", "±1-month pooled (S2, v2.1)", "no ratio clipping", "trace 1 mm", "30 quantiles", "reference, detrended target")
PD1 <- rbind(PDIAG[, c(list(season = "all months"), lapply(.SD, function(x) mean(abs(x)))), .SDcols = vcols],
             PDIAG[, lapply(.SD, function(x) mean(abs(x))), by = season, .SDcols = vcols])
PD2 <- PDIAG[, .(obs_shift = mean(obs_shift), mod_shift = mean(mod_shift), signed_raw = mean(raw), signed_qdm = mean(reference),
                 corr_obs_shift_vs_qdm_bias = cor(obs_shift, reference)), by = .(cal, season)]
KEY$qdm_precip_diag <- list(abs_median_bias = PD1, decomposition = PD2)
fwrite(PDIAG, file.path(ROOT, "07_bias_correction", "qdm_precip_diagnostics_cells.csv"))
fwrite(PD1, file.path(ROOT, "07_bias_correction", "qdm_precip_diagnostics_summary.csv")); fwrite(PD2, file.path(ROOT, "07_bias_correction", "qdm_precip_bias_decomposition.csv"))
knitr::kable(PD1, digits = 1, caption = "Precipitation |median bias| (%) in the validation half: raw, QDM reference and one-at-a-time variants (diagnostic only)")
knitr::kable(PD2, digits = 2, caption = "Decomposition: median shift of observations and raw model between halves, signed bias raw vs QDM (%)")

# Future projections (III-F)

Each retained model's corrected historical (1981–2014) and scenario (2015–2100) series were joined. Penman–Monteith ET₀ was recomputed from the corrected inputs, and every index was **calibrated on that model's own 1985–2014 baseline**. Changes are relative to 1985–2014.
A change is **robust** when at least 80% of the retained models agree on its sign **and** a Wilcoxon signed-rank test of the model changes rejects zero at p < 0.05. Ensemble means use the skill weights.

```{r projections}
model_series <- function(mdl, s, src = QDMX) {
  x <- lapply(VARS6, function(v) rbind(src[[mdl]]$historical[[v]], src[[mdl]][[s]][[v]])); names(x) <- VARS6
  mo <- c(MON_H, MON_F); yr <- c(YR_H, YR_F)
  list(x = x, months = mo, years = yr, dates = c(D_H, D_F),
       et_pm = gcm_et0(x, mo, "pm", days_in_month(c(D_H, D_F))), et_hg = gcm_et0(x, mo, "hg", days_in_month(c(D_H, D_F))))
}
SEL_FUN <- function(P, PET, months, years, ref = BASE, type = SEL_TYPE, k = SEL_K) {
  if (type == "SPI") std_index(P, k, "spi", ref = ref) else if (type == "SPEI") std_index(as.matrix(P) - as.matrix(PET), k, "spei", ref = ref)
  else rdi_st(P, PET, k, months, years, ref)
}
PROJ <- cached("projections", {
  sapply(QDM_MODELS, function(mdl) sapply(SCEN, function(s) {
    logp("projection", mdl, s)
    ms <- model_series(mdl, s)
    Preg <- wmean(ms$x$pr, W_REG); Ereg <- wmean(ms$et_pm, W_REG); Hreg <- wmean(ms$et_hg, W_REG)
    mr <- model_series(mdl, s, src = GCM)                       # NEX-GDDP as published (no QDM): sensitivity
    Praw <- wmean(mr$x$pr, W_REG); Eraw <- wmean(mr$et_pm, W_REG)
    list(months = ms$months, years = ms$years, dates = ms$dates,
         raw = list(P = Praw, ET0 = Eraw, sel = SEL_FUN(Praw, Eraw, ms$months, ms$years)[, 1]),
         reg = list(P = Preg, ET0 = Ereg, ET0_HG = Hreg, Tmax = wmean(ms$x$tasmax, W_REG), Tmin = wmean(ms$x$tasmin, W_REG),
                    idx = all_indices(Preg, Ereg, ms$months, ms$years),
                    sel_hg = SEL_FUN(Preg, Hreg, ms$months, ms$years, type = if (SEL_TYPE == "SPI") "SPEI" else SEL_TYPE),
                    spei_sel_pm = std_index(Preg - Ereg, SEL_K, "spei"),
                    sel_alt = SEL_FUN(Preg, Ereg, ms$months, ms$years, ref = BASE_ALT)),
         cell_sel = SEL_FUN(ms$x$pr, ms$et_pm, ms$months, ms$years),
         cell_spei12 = std_index(ms$x$pr - ms$et_pm, 12, "spei"),
         cellP = ms$x$pr, cellE = ms$et_pm)
  }, simplify = FALSE), simplify = FALSE)
})
per_metrics <- function(pr, per, idx = NULL, thr = THR) {
  i <- pr$years >= per[1] & pr$years <= per[2]
  x <- if (is.null(idx)) pr$reg$idx[[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1] else idx
  cs <- char_summary(x, pr$dates, pr$years, per, thr)
  cbind(cs, P = sum(pr$reg$P[i]) / (per[2] - per[1] + 1), ET0 = sum(pr$reg$ET0[i]) / (per[2] - per[1] + 1),
        WB = sum(pr$reg$P[i] - pr$reg$ET0[i]) / (per[2] - per[1] + 1), Tmax = mean(pr$reg$Tmax[i]))
}
CHG_ALL <- rbindlist(lapply(QDM_MODELS, function(mdl) rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) {
  pr <- PROJ[[mdl]][[s]]; b <- per_metrics(pr, BASE)
  rbindlist(lapply(c("near", "mid", "far"), function(p) { f <- per_metrics(pr, PERIODS[[p]])
    data.table(model = mdl, scenario = s, period = p, d_freq = f$freq_pct - b$freq_pct, d_epd = f$events_per_decade - b$events_per_decade,
               d_D = f$D_mean - b$D_mean, d_S = f$S_mean - b$S_mean, d_I = f$I_mean - b$I_mean, d_Dmax = f$D_max - b$D_max,
               d_P = 100 * (f$P - b$P) / b$P, d_ET0 = 100 * (f$ET0 - b$ET0) / b$ET0, d_WB = f$WB - b$WB, d_Tmax = f$Tmax - b$Tmax,
               base_freq = b$freq_pct, base_D = b$D_mean, base_S = b$S_mean, base_I = b$I_mean) }))
}))))
CHG <- CHG_ALL[model %in% TOP]                                   # primary ensemble
robust <- function(d) { d <- d[!is.na(d)]; agree <- max(mean(d > 0), mean(d < 0))
  p <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(d, mu = 0, exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  c(agree = agree, p = p, robust = as.numeric(agree >= cfg$ensemble$robust_agreement & !is.na(p) & p < cfg$ensemble$robust_alpha)) }
ens <- function(dt, keys) {
  vars <- grep("^d_", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  dt[, {
    w <- WTS[model] / sum(WTS[model])
    rbindlist(lapply(vars, function(v) { x <- get(v); rb <- robust(x)
      data.table(metric = v, wmean = sum(w * x, na.rm = TRUE), p10 = quantile(x, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), p90 = quantile(x, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
                 agree = rb["agree"], wilcox_p = rb["p"], robust = rb["robust"] == 1) }))
  }, by = keys]
}
ENS <- ens(CHG, c("scenario", "period"))
fwrite(CHG, file.path(ROOT, "08_projections", "regional_changes_by_model.csv")); fwrite(ENS, file.path(ROOT, "08_projections", "regional_changes_ensemble.csv"))
KEY$ens_changes <- ENS
BASEV <- CHG[, .(freq = mean(base_freq), D = mean(base_D), S = mean(base_S), I = mean(base_I)), by = model]
KEY$model_baseline_char <- BASEV[, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = -"model"]
```

```{r seasonal}
# Where in the year does the change occur? Frequency of SEL <= -1 by season of the index end month, plus the
# December value (end of the Oct-Dec wheat-sowing window, the index month selected by the yield correlation).
SEAS <- c(DJF = 12, DJF = 1, DJF = 2, MAM = 3, MAM = 4, MAM = 5, JJA = 6, JJA = 7, JJA = 8, SON = 9, SON = 10, SON = 11)
seas_of <- function(m) names(SEAS)[match(m, SEAS)]
SC <- rbindlist(lapply(TOP, function(mdl) rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) { pr <- PROJ[[mdl]][[s]]
  x <- pr$reg$idx[[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1]; se <- seas_of(pr$months)
  fr <- function(per, sel) 100 * mean(x[pr$years >= per[1] & pr$years <= per[2] & sel] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE)
  mP <- function(per, mm) mean(pr$reg$P[pr$years >= per[1] & pr$years <= per[2] & pr$months %in% mm])
  mE <- function(per, mm) mean(pr$reg$ET0[pr$years >= per[1] & pr$years <= per[2] & pr$months %in% mm])
  rbindlist(lapply(c("mid", "far"), function(p) rbindlist(lapply(c("DJF", "MAM", "JJA", "SON", "Dec (sowing)"), function(g) {
    sel <- if (g == "Dec (sowing)") pr$months == 12 else se == g
    mm <- if (g == "Dec (sowing)") 10:12 else SEAS[names(SEAS) == g]
    data.table(model = mdl, scenario = s, period = p, season = g, d_freq = fr(PERIODS[[p]], sel) - fr(BASE, sel),
               d_P = 100 * (mP(PERIODS[[p]], mm) / mP(BASE, mm) - 1), d_ET0 = 100 * (mE(PERIODS[[p]], mm) / mE(BASE, mm) - 1)) }))))
}))))
SCE <- SC[, { w <- WTS[model] / sum(WTS[model]); rb <- robust(d_freq)
  .(d_freq = sum(w * d_freq), d_P = sum(w * d_P), d_ET0 = sum(w * d_ET0), agree = rb["agree"], wilcox_p = rb["p"], robust = rb["robust"] == 1) }, by = .(scenario, period, season)]
KEY$seasonal_changes <- SCE
fwrite(SCE, file.path(ROOT, "08_projections", "seasonal_changes_ensemble.csv"))
knitr::kable(SCE, digits = 1, caption = paste0("Seasonal change in ", SEL_NAME, " drought frequency (%-pt) and in P and ET0 (%) of the corresponding months"))
```

In Fig. 6 a cell is marked (×) as robust only when at least 80% of the retained models agree on the sign of its change **and** the Wilcoxon signed-rank p-value, adjusted with the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure across all cells of that map (one map per scenario and period; α = 0.05), is below 0.05 (v2.2 Item 5). The same mask defines the binary hotspot exposure. Shares without the FDR control are reported for comparison.

# Joint duration–severity return periods (Eq. 8)

v2.1 (audit M3): drought events (run theory, threshold −1, regional `r SEL_NAME`) were **declustered**, merging runs separated by a single non-drought month. The events of all retained GCMs were **pooled** for each set: the baseline, each scenario × period, and each GWL (both scenario windows of every model).
- **Marginals** (v3.1): the duration D is a whole number of months, so D − 1 was fitted by AIC among the geometric, Poisson and negative binomial distributions; the severity S, which is at least 1 because every drought month adds |index| ≥ 1, as S − 1: semiparametrically (empirical distribution up to the 90th percentile, generalized Pareto tail above it, fitted by maximum likelihood) for the pooled ensemble sets (≥ 100 events), and by AIC among the exponential, gamma, Weibull and log-normal distributions for smaller samples. Both were tested with Kolmogorov–Smirnov and Anderson–Darling statistics using parametric-bootstrap p-values (N = 1,000), refitting the margin in each replicate. Pseudo-observations use mid-ranks for ties (deterministic).
- The **copula** was selected by AIC among the Gaussian, Student-t, Clayton, Gumbel, Frank, Joe, BB1 and BB7 families, and was tested with a parametric-bootstrap Cramér–von Mises test (Sₙ, Genest et al., N = 1,000).
- **95% CIs** come from a **model-level bootstrap**: the GCMs were resampled with replacement, their events pooled, and the model refitted with the same families (1,000 resamples). The observed series uses an event bootstrap.
- The **effective record length** L is the number of pooled model-years. Return periods above 2L are flagged as extrapolated and not reported.
- **Primary estimator:** if fewer than 80% of the pooled fits pass the copula test, the **empirical Bernstein (beta) copula** is primary. The parametric copula and the distribution-free count estimate are reported as checks.
- **Diagnostic:** the per-GCM fits (v2) are kept, with each model's event count and CvM pass rate.

T_AND = μ / [1 − F_D(d) − F_S(s) + C(F_D(d), F_S(s))], where μ is the mean inter-arrival time of the pooled events. GCM skill weights are not used here: every model contributes its events with equal weight (DEVIATIONS A4).

```{r copula}
# ---------------- v2 item 5: per-GCM copulas on declustered events ----------------
decl_events <- function(x, dates, thr = THR, tc = 1) {   # run theory + pooling of events separated by <= tc non-drought months
  b <- !is.na(x) & x <= thr; if (!any(b)) return(data.table(start = as.Date(character()), end = as.Date(character()), D = integer(), S = numeric(), I = numeric()))
  r <- rle(b); e <- cumsum(r$lengths); s <- e - r$lengths + 1; v <- r$values
  inner <- which(!v & r$lengths <= tc & seq_along(v) > 1 & seq_along(v) < length(v)); inner <- inner[v[inner - 1] & v[inner + 1]]
  g <- b; for (i in inner) g[s[i]:e[i]] <- TRUE
  r2 <- rle(g); e2 <- cumsum(r2$lengths); s2 <- e2 - r2$lengths + 1; k <- which(r2$values)
  data.table(start = dates[s2[k]], end = dates[e2[k]], D = r2$lengths[k],
             S = sapply(k, function(i) { idx <- s2[i]:e2[i]; sum(abs(x[idx][b[idx]])) }))[, I := S / D][]
}
# v3.1: duration D is a count of whole months (>= 1), so it gets discrete margins on D - 1 (shifted geometric, Poisson, negative
# binomial; AIC); severity S stays continuous (exponential, gamma, Weibull, lognormal; AIC). Discrete margins make the Item 2
# continuity point exact: F_D(k - 0.5) = P(D <= k - 1). Marginal goodness of fit: parametric-bootstrap KS/AD (gof_marg).
DISC_FAM <- c(geom1 = "geom", pois1 = "pois", nbinom1 = "nbinom")
fit_marg <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  if (all(x == round(x))) {
    fits <- lapply(DISC_FAM, function(d) tryCatch(logw(fitdist(x - 1, d, method = "mle"), paste("fit_marg mle", d)), error = function(e) NULL))
    ok <- !sapply(fits, is.null); fits <- fits[ok]; a <- sapply(fits, function(f) f$aic); b <- fits[[which.min(a)]]
    return(list(dist = names(fits)[which.min(a)], est = b$estimate, ks_p = NA_real_))
  }
  # severity: every drought month contributes |index| >= 1 (threshold -1), so S >= 1; S - 1 is fitted (known lower bound, "<dist>.loc1").
  # Large pooled samples (n >= 100, i.e. >= 10 tail exceedances): semiparametric margin (empirical body + GPD tail above the 90th
  # percentile, scripts/R/return_period_helpers.R), because the parametric families are rejected there; smaller samples: AIC family.
  if (length(x) >= 100) return(list(dist = "egpd", est = fit_egpd(x), ks_p = NA_real_))
  cands <- c("exp", "gamma", "weibull", "lnorm"); z <- pmax(x - 1, 1e-6)
  fits <- lapply(cands, function(d) tryCatch(logw(fitdist(z, d, method = "mle"), paste("fit_marg mle", d)),
                                             error = function(e) tryCatch(logw(fitdist(z, d, method = "mme"), paste("fit_marg mme", d)), error = function(e2) NULL)))
  ok <- !sapply(fits, is.null); fits <- fits[ok]; a <- sapply(fits, function(f) f$aic); b <- fits[[which.min(a)]]
  list(dist = paste0(b$distname, ".loc1"), est = b$estimate, ks_p = logw(do.call(ks.test, c(list(z, paste0("p", b$distname)), as.list(b$estimate)))$p.value, "fit_marg ks.test"))
}
refit_marg <- function(x, dist) { x <- x[x > 0]
  if (dist == "egpd") return(list(dist = dist, est = fit_egpd(x)))
  if (grepl("\\.loc1$", dist)) { r <- refit_marg(pmax(x - 1, 1e-6) + 1e-12, sub("\\.loc1$", "", dist)); return(list(dist = dist, est = r$est)) }   # S - 1
  if (dist == "geom1") return(list(dist = dist, est = c(prob = 1 / (1 + mean(x - 1)))))
  if (dist == "pois1") return(list(dist = dist, est = c(lambda = mean(x - 1))))
  if (dist == "nbinom1") { f <- tryCatch(logw(fitdist(x - 1, "nbinom", method = "mle"), "refit_marg nbinom"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(f)) return(list(dist = "geom1", est = c(prob = 1 / (1 + mean(x - 1))))); return(list(dist = dist, est = f$estimate)) }
  if (dist == "lnorm") return(list(dist = dist, est = c(meanlog = mean(log(x)), sdlog = sqrt(mean((log(x) - mean(log(x)))^2)))))
  if (dist == "exp") return(list(dist = dist, est = c(rate = 1 / mean(x))))
  f <- logw(fitdist(x, dist, method = "mle"), paste("refit_marg", dist)); list(dist = dist, est = f$estimate) }
source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "R", "return_period_helpers.R"))   # v2.2 Item 2: pmarg, qmarg, T3, exceeds_duration, ref_duration_k, duration_cdf_point
FAMS <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9)     # Gaussian, t, Clayton, Gumbel, Frank, Joe, BB1, BB7
fit_one <- function(ev, years) {
  mD <- fit_marg(ev$D); mS <- fit_marg(ev$S); U <- VineCopula::pobs(cbind(ev$D, ev$S), ties.method = "average")
  cop <- BiCopSelect(U[, 1], U[, 2], familyset = FAMS, selectioncrit = "AIC", rotations = FALSE)
  list(mD = mD, mS = mS, cop = cop, U = U, ev = ev, mu = years / nrow(ev), n = nrow(ev),
       tau_emp = cor(ev$D, ev$S, method = "kendall"), tau_p = cor.test(ev$D, ev$S, method = "kendall", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
}
cvm_pb <- function(U, cop, N) {           # parametric-bootstrap Cramer-von Mises S_n test (Genest, Remillard & Beaudoin 2009)
  Cn <- function(V) sapply(seq_len(nrow(V)), function(i) mean(V[, 1] <= V[i, 1] & V[, 2] <= V[i, 2]))
  Sn <- function(V, cp) sum((Cn(V) - BiCopCDF(V[, 1], V[, 2], cp))^2)
  s0 <- Sn(U, cop); n <- nrow(U)
  sb <- vapply(seq_len(N), function(b) { z <- BiCopSim(n, obj = cop); V <- VineCopula::pobs(z)
    cp <- tryCatch(BiCopEst(V[, 1], V[, 2], family = cop$family, method = if (cop$family %in% c(2, 7, 9)) "mle" else "itau"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(cp)) NA_real_ else Sn(V, cp) }, numeric(1))
  c(Sn = s0, p = mean(sb >= s0, na.rm = TRUE))
}
boot_one <- function(f, d, s, N) {
  out <- array(NA_real_, c(N, length(d), 3))
  for (b in seq_len(N)) { i <- sample(f$n, replace = TRUE); e <- f$ev[i]
    g <- tryCatch({ mD <- refit_marg(e$D, f$mD$dist); mS <- refit_marg(e$S, f$mS$dist); U <- VineCopula::pobs(cbind(e$D, e$S), ties.method = "average")
      cp <- BiCopEst(U[, 1], U[, 2], family = f$cop$family, method = if (f$cop$family %in% c(2, 7, 9)) "mle" else "itau")
      list(mD = mD, mS = mS, cop = cp, U = U, ev = e, mu = f$mu) }, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(g)) out[b, , ] <- T3(g, d, s) }
  out
}
# ---- event sets per GCM ----
sel_x <- function(pr) pr$reg$idx[[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1]
ev_period <- function(pr, per) { i <- pr$years >= per[1] & pr$years <= per[2]; list(ev = decl_events(sel_x(pr)[i], pr$dates[i]), years = per[2] - per[1] + 1) }
SETNAMES <- c("Baseline (1985–2014)", paste(rep(SCEN_LAB, each = 3), c("near", "mid", "far")), paste0("+", unlist(cfg$indices$gwl), " °C"))
ev_sets <- function(mdl) {
  out <- list(); out[["Baseline (1985–2014)"]] <- ev_period(PROJ[[mdl]][[SCEN[1]]], BASE)
  for (s in SCEN) for (p in c("near", "mid", "far")) out[[paste(SCEN_LAB[s], p)]] <- ev_period(PROJ[[mdl]][[s]], PERIODS[[p]])
  for (g in unlist(cfg$indices$gwl)) { w <- GWLCHG[model == mdl & gwl == g]; if (!nrow(w)) next
    l <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(w)), function(i) ev_period(PROJ[[mdl]][[w$scenario[i]]], c(w$start[i], w$end[i])))
    out[[paste0("+", g, " °C")]] <- list(ev = rbindlist(lapply(l, `[[`, "ev")), years = sum(sapply(l, `[[`, "years"))) }
  out
}
EVS <- sapply(TOP, ev_sets, simplify = FALSE)
EV_OBS_D <- decl_events(IDX_REG$grid[[paste0(SEL_TYPE, SEL_K)]][, 1], DATES_OBS)
# reference events: univariate 10/25/50-yr D and S of the pooled model baseline (AIC margins: discrete for D, continuous for S)
pool_base <- rbindlist(lapply(TOP, function(m) EVS[[m]][["Baseline (1985–2014)"]]$ev))
mu_pool <- sum(sapply(TOP, function(m) EVS[[m]][["Baseline (1985–2014)"]]$years)) / nrow(pool_base)
mDp <- fit_marg(pool_base$D); mSp <- fit_marg(pool_base$S)
REF <- data.table(T = c(10, 25, 50))[, `:=`(d = qmarg(mDp, 1 - mu_pool / T), s = qmarg(mSp, 1 - mu_pool / T))][, k := ref_duration_k(d)]   # k: whole months (Item 2)
NB <- cfg$ensemble$bootstrap_n
COP <- cached("copula_v2", {
  jobs <- c(lapply(TOP, function(m) lapply(names(EVS[[m]]), function(st) list(model = m, set = st))) |> unlist(recursive = FALSE),
            list(list(model = "observed", set = "Observed (1981–2024)")))
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(max(1, min(6, parallel::detectCores() - 2)))
  on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl))
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(VineCopula); library(copula); library(fitdistrplus); library(data.table) }))
  parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("logw", "WLOG", "MASTER_PID", "DISC_FAM", "shifted", "loc1", "base_dist", "fit_egpd", "p_egpd", "q_egpd", "exceeds_duration", "ref_duration_k", "duration_cdf_point", "EVS", "EV_OBS_D", "fit_one", "fit_marg", "refit_marg", "pmarg", "cvm_pb", "T3", "boot_one", "REF", "NB", "FAMS", "SEED"), envir = environment())
  res <- parallel::parLapply(cl, jobs, function(j) {
    set.seed(SEED + match(j$set, c(names(EVS[[1]]), "Observed (1981–2024)")) * 1000 + nchar(j$model))
    e <- if (j$model == "observed") list(ev = EV_OBS_D, years = 44) else EVS[[j$model]][[j$set]]
    if (is.null(e) || nrow(e$ev) < 8) return(NULL)
    f <- fit_one(e$ev, e$years); g <- cvm_pb(f$U, f$cop, NB)
    list(model = j$model, set = j$set, n = f$n, mu = f$mu, family = BiCopName(f$cop$family, short = FALSE), par = f$cop$par, par2 = f$cop$par2,
         tau_emp = f$tau_emp, tau_p = f$tau_p, tau_cop = f$cop$tau, aic = f$cop$AIC, cvm_Sn = g[["Sn"]], cvm_p = g[["p"]],
         marg_D = f$mD$dist, marg_S = f$mS$dist, T = T3(f, REF$d, REF$s), boot = boot_one(f, REF$d, REF$s, NB))
  })
  Filter(Negate(is.null), res)
})
CFIT <- rbindlist(lapply(COP, function(r) data.table(model = r$model, set = r$set, n = r$n, mu = r$mu, family = r$family, tau_emp = r$tau_emp, tau_p = r$tau_p,
                                                     tau_cop = r$tau_cop, cvm_p = r$cvm_p, marg_D = r$marg_D, marg_S = r$marg_S)))
CFIT[, pass := cvm_p >= 0.05]
PASS_PCT <- 100 * CFIT[model != "observed", mean(pass)]
fwrite(CFIT, file.path(ROOT, "09_return_periods", "copula_per_gcm_fits.csv"))
EST <- colnames(COP[[1]]$T)                               # c("parametric", "bernstein", "count"): same order as T3()
stopifnot(identical(EST, c("parametric", "bernstein", "count")))
# ---------------- v2.1 (audit M3): pooled-ensemble fits, model-level bootstrap, marginal GoF, extrapolation flag ----------------
# Events of all retained GCMs are pooled per set (baseline, scenario x period, GWL); marginals and copula are selected by AIC on
# the pooled sample. 95% CIs: model-level bootstrap (resample the GCMs with replacement, pool their events, refit with the same
# families). Marginal goodness of fit: Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Anderson-Darling with parametric-bootstrap p-values (D is simulated
# and rounded up to whole months, as observed). Effective record length L = pooled model-years; T > 2L is flagged as extrapolated.
ad_stat <- function(x, Fx) { n <- length(x); u <- pmin(pmax(sort(Fx(x)), 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10); -n - mean((2 * seq_len(n) - 1) * (log(u) + log(1 - rev(u)))) }
gof_marg <- function(x, m, N, discrete) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  ks_stat1 <- function(z, Fn) { z <- sort(z); n <- length(z); u <- Fn(z); max(pmax(seq_len(n) / n - u, u - (seq_len(n) - 1) / n)) }   # = ks.test()$statistic
  st <- function(z, mm) c(KS = ks_stat1(z, function(q) pmarg(mm, q)), AD = ad_stat(z, function(q) pmarg(mm, q)))
  s0 <- st(x, m)
  sb <- t(vapply(seq_len(N), function(b) { z <- qmarg(m, runif(length(x))); if (discrete) z <- pmax(ceiling(z), 1)
    mm <- tryCatch(refit_marg(z, m$dist), error = function(e) NULL); if (is.null(mm)) c(NA_real_, NA_real_) else st(z, mm) }, numeric(2)))
  c(KS = unname(s0[1]), KS_p = mean(sb[, 1] >= s0[1], na.rm = TRUE), AD = unname(s0[2]), AD_p = mean(sb[, 2] >= s0[2], na.rm = TRUE))
}
pool_ev <- function(st, mods) { ok <- mods[sapply(mods, function(m) !is.null(EVS[[m]][[st]]))]
  list(ev = rbindlist(lapply(ok, function(m) cbind(model = m, copy(EVS[[m]][[st]]$ev)))), years = setNames(sapply(ok, function(m) EVS[[m]][[st]]$years), ok)) }
POOLED <- cached("copula_pooled_v2_1", {
  jobs <- c(SETNAMES, "Observed (1981–2024)")
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(max(1, min(6, parallel::detectCores() - 2)))
  on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl))
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(VineCopula); library(copula); library(fitdistrplus); library(data.table) }))
  parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("logw", "WLOG", "MASTER_PID", "DISC_FAM", "shifted", "loc1", "base_dist", "fit_egpd", "p_egpd", "q_egpd", "exceeds_duration", "ref_duration_k", "duration_cdf_point", "jobs", "EVS", "EV_OBS_D", "TOP", "pool_ev", "fit_one", "fit_marg", "refit_marg", "pmarg", "qmarg", "cvm_pb", "gof_marg", "ad_stat",
                                "T3", "REF", "NB", "FAMS", "SEED"), envir = environment())
  res <- parallel::parLapply(cl, jobs, function(st) {
    set.seed(SEED + match(st, jobs))
    if (st == "Observed (1981–2024)") { ev <- cbind(model = "observed", copy(EV_OBS_D)); yrs <- c(observed = 44) } else { p <- pool_ev(st, TOP); ev <- p$ev; yrs <- p$years }
    if (nrow(ev) < 8) return(NULL)
    f <- fit_one(ev, sum(yrs)); g <- cvm_pb(f$U, f$cop, NB)
    gD <- gof_marg(ev$D, f$mD, NB, discrete = TRUE); gS <- gof_marg(ev$S, f$mS, NB, discrete = FALSE)
    by_m <- split(ev, by = "model", keep.by = FALSE); mods <- names(yrs)
    boot <- array(NA_real_, c(NB, nrow(REF), 3))
    for (b in seq_len(NB)) {
      if (length(mods) > 1) { ms <- sample(mods, replace = TRUE); e <- rbindlist(by_m[ms]); y <- sum(yrs[ms]) } else { e <- ev[sample(.N, replace = TRUE)]; y <- sum(yrs) }
      fb <- tryCatch({ U <- VineCopula::pobs(cbind(e$D, e$S), ties.method = "average")
        list(mD = refit_marg(e$D, f$mD$dist), mS = refit_marg(e$S, f$mS$dist), U = U, ev = e, mu = y / nrow(e),
             cop = BiCopEst(U[, 1], U[, 2], family = f$cop$family, method = if (f$cop$family %in% c(2, 7, 9)) "mle" else "itau")) }, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(fb)) boot[b, , ] <- T3(fb, REF$d, REF$s) }
    list(set = st, n = f$n, years = sum(yrs), n_by_model = table(ev$model), mu = f$mu, family = BiCopName(f$cop$family, short = FALSE), par = f$cop$par, par2 = f$cop$par2,
         tau_emp = f$tau_emp, tau_cop = f$cop$tau, cvm_p = g[["p"]], marg_D = f$mD$dist, marg_S = f$mS$dist, gof_D = gD, gof_S = gS,
         n_exceed = sapply(seq_len(nrow(REF)), function(k) sum(exceeds_duration(ev$D, REF$d[k]) & ev$S >= REF$s[k])), T = T3(f, REF$d, REF$s), boot = boot, fit = f)
  })
  Filter(Negate(is.null), res)
})
PFIT <- rbindlist(lapply(POOLED, function(r) data.table(set = r$set, n = r$n, model_years = r$years, n_models = length(r$n_by_model),
  n_per_model = if (length(r$n_by_model) > 1) sprintf("%d (%d–%d)", as.integer(median(r$n_by_model)), min(r$n_by_model), max(r$n_by_model)) else as.character(r$n),
  family = r$family, tau_emp = r$tau_emp, tau_cop = r$tau_cop, cvm_p = r$cvm_p, marg_D = r$marg_D, D_KS_p = r$gof_D[["KS_p"]], D_AD_p = r$gof_D[["AD_p"]],
  marg_S = r$marg_S, S_KS_p = r$gof_S[["KS_p"]], S_AD_p = r$gof_S[["AD_p"]], n_exceed_25yr = r$n_exceed[2])))
PASS_POOLED <- 100 * PFIT[set != "Observed (1981–2024)", mean(cvm_p >= 0.05)]
PRIMARY <- if (PASS_POOLED < 80) "bernstein" else "parametric"
KEY$copula_gof <- list(pass_pct = PASS_PCT, n_fits = CFIT[model != "observed", .N], median_n = CFIT[model != "observed", median(n)],
                       per_gcm_n_range = range(CFIT[model != "observed", n]), families = CFIT[model != "observed", .N, by = family][order(-N)],
                       tau_abs_diff_median = CFIT[model != "observed", median(abs(tau_emp - tau_cop))], observed = CFIT[model == "observed"],
                       pooled = PFIT, pooled_pass_pct = PASS_POOLED, primary = PRIMARY,
                       note = "per-GCM fits are a diagnostic; return periods come from the pooled-ensemble fits with a model-level bootstrap")

ENS_T <- rbindlist(lapply(POOLED, function(r) rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(REF)), function(k) rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(EST), function(e)
  data.table(set = r$set, T_ref = REF$T[k], estimator = EST[e], T_and = r$T[k, e], lo = quantile(r$boot[, k, e], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
             hi = quantile(r$boot[, k, e], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE), model_years = r$years, n_exceed = r$n_exceed[k])))))))
ENS_T[, extrapolated := !is.finite(T_and) | T_and > 2 * model_years]
# assertion (audit C1): every value must sit under the column name it came from
for (r in POOLED) for (e in EST) for (k in seq_len(nrow(REF)))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(ENS_T[set == r$set & estimator == e & T_ref == REF$T[k], T_and], unname(r$T[k, e]))))
KEY$copula_T <- ENS_T; KEY$ref_events <- REF
# Item 2 report: the same pooled fits evaluated with the previous (v2.1) duration rule

  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(REF)), function(k) data.table(set = r0$set, T_ref = REF$T[k], d_ref = REF$d[k], k_months = REF$k[k],
    estimator = EST, T_new = as.numeric(tn[k, EST]), T_old_rule = as.numeric(to[k, EST])))) }))[, diff := T_new - T_old_rule]
KEY$rp_rule_comparison <- RPRULE

fmtT <- function(x, lo, hi, ex, L) ifelse(ex, "extrapolated (> 2L)", sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%s)", x, lo, ifelse(is.finite(hi) & hi <= 2 * L, sprintf("%.1f", hi), "> 2L")))

               `CvM p` = round(cvm_p, 3), `D: margin, AD p` = sprintf("%s, %.2f", marg_D, D_AD_p), `S: margin, AD p` = sprintf("%s, %.2f", marg_S, S_AD_p),

                         "Gaussian, t, Clayton, Gumbel, Frank, Joe, BB1, BB7 with a parametric-bootstrap Cramér–von Mises test (N = ", NB, "). 95% CIs from ", NB,

  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), position = position_dodge(0.6), size = 0.18, linewidth = 0.3) + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Baseline = "black", `SSP2-4.5` = "#0072B2", `SSP5-8.5` = "#D55E00", GWL = "#009E73"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 4), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(T[AND]~"of the baseline 25-yr event (yr, log)"), tag = "(b)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 6), legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical")
fig8 <- p8a + p8b + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.5))
save_fig(fig8, "Fig08_copula_return_periods", IEEE2, 3.6); fig8
```

# District-level exposure of rainfed crops (III-F)

Hotspots are 0.25° cells with a **robust increase** in `r SEL_NAME` drought frequency. Rainfed wheat and groundnut physical areas (SPAM2010, 5′) were redistributed to 0.01° pixels in proportion to the ESA WorldCover 2021 cropland area. They were then scaled so that each district total equals the official un-irrigated area reported by the Crop Reporting Service Punjab (mean of 2021-22 to 2023-24; Table S2), and summed within the hotspots of each district and ICT. SPAM2010 therefore sets only the allocation within a district.

```{r exposure}
EXP <- cached("exposure_layers", {
  wc <- rast(file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "worldcover_fractions_0p01.tif"))[["cropland"]]
  crop_ha <- wc * cellSize(wc, unit = "ha")
  sp <- rast(file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "spam2010_potohar.tif"))
  names(sp) <- c("WHEA_R", "WHEA_A", "GROU_R", "GROU_A")
  zid <- rast(sp[[1]]); values(zid) <- seq_len(ncell(zid))
  z01 <- resample(zid, wc, method = "near")
  csum <- zonal(crop_ha, z01, "sum"); names(csum) <- c("z", "crop_sum")
  out <- list(crop_ha = wrap(crop_ha))
  for (L in c("WHEA_R", "GROU_R")) {
    a <- data.frame(z = seq_len(ncell(zid)), area = values(sp[[L]])[, 1]); a <- merge(a, csum, by = "z", all.x = TRUE)
    zv <- values(z01)[, 1]; cv <- values(crop_ha)[, 1]
    ia <- match(zv, a$z); share <- cv / a$crop_sum[ia]; share[!is.finite(share)] <- 0
    r <- rast(wc); values(r) <- a$area[ia] * share; out[[L]] <- wrap(r)
  }
  dz <- rasterize(vect(dist), wc, field = "district"); out$dist <- wrap(dz)
  out
})
crop_ha <- unwrap(EXP$crop_ha); whe <- unwrap(EXP$WHEA_R); gro <- unwrap(EXP$GROU_R); dz <- unwrap(EXP$dist)
hot_mask <- function(s, p) { h <- CE[scenario == s & period == p & robust == TRUE & d_freq > 0]
  r <- rast(crop_ha); v <- rep(0, ncell(r)); xy <- xyFromCell(r, 1:ncell(r))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(h))) v[abs(xy[, 1] - h$lon[i]) < 0.125 & abs(xy[, 2] - h$lat[i]) < 0.125] <- 1
  values(r) <- v; r }
dvals <- values(dz)[, 1]; dlev <- levels(dz)[[1]]
EXPO <- rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) rbindlist(lapply(c("near", "mid", "far"), function(p) {
  hm <- values(hot_mask(s, p))[, 1]
  data.table(dist_id = dvals, wheat = values(whe)[, 1], gnut = values(gro)[, 1], crop = values(crop_ha)[, 1], hot = hm)[!is.na(dist_id),
    .(wheat_total = sum(wheat, na.rm = TRUE), wheat_exp = sum(wheat * hot, na.rm = TRUE), gnut_total = sum(gnut, na.rm = TRUE),
      gnut_exp = sum(gnut * hot, na.rm = TRUE), crop_total = sum(crop, na.rm = TRUE), crop_exp = sum(crop * hot, na.rm = TRUE)), by = dist_id][,
    `:=`(scenario = s, period = p)] }))))
EXPO[, district := dlev[match(dist_id, dlev[, 1]), 2]]
# v2: SPAM2010 gives the allocation within each district; district totals are scaled to the official CRS un-irrigated (rainfed)
# area, mean of 2021-22 to 2023-24 (SPAM2010 rainfed wheat is ~2.3x the reported area; see Table S2)
crs_ref <- function(f) fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "yields", f))[harvest_year %in% 2022:2024, .(ref = 1000 * mean(rainfed_area_000ha)), by = district][
  , district := fifelse(district == "Islamabad", "Islamabad (ICT)", district)][]
EXPO <- merge(EXPO, crs_ref("district_wheat_irrigation_crs.csv")[, .(district, ref_w = ref)], by = "district", all.x = TRUE)
EXPO <- merge(EXPO, crs_ref("district_groundnut.csv")[, .(district, ref_g = ref)], by = "district", all.x = TRUE)
EXPO[, `:=`(spam_wheat_total = wheat_total, spam_gnut_total = gnut_total,
            f_w = fifelse(wheat_total > 0, ref_w / wheat_total, 0), f_g = fifelse(gnut_total > 0, ref_g / gnut_total, 0))]
EXPO[, `:=`(wheat_total = wheat_total * f_w, wheat_exp = wheat_exp * f_w, gnut_total = gnut_total * f_g, gnut_exp = gnut_exp * f_g)]
KEY$exposure_scaling <- unique(EXPO[, .(district, spam_wheat_total, crs_wheat_rainfed = ref_w, f_w, spam_gnut_total, crs_gnut_rainfed = ref_g, f_g)])
fwrite(EXPO, file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "exposure_by_district.csv"))
KEY$exposure <- EXPO
# binary hotspot exposure: kept as a secondary measure (Table S3)
TS3 <- dcast(EXPO[period %in% c("mid", "far")], district + round(wheat_total) + round(gnut_total) + round(crop_total) ~ scenario + period,
             value.var = c("wheat_exp", "gnut_exp"), fun.aggregate = function(x) round(sum(x)))
setnames(TS3, 2:4, c("Rainfed wheat (ha)", "Rainfed groundnut (ha)", "Cropland (ha)"))
save_table(TS3, "S3", paste0("Binary exposure (secondary measure): rainfed wheat and groundnut area (ha) inside cells with a robust increase in ", SEL_NAME, " drought frequency"),
           "TableS3_exposure_binary", note = "Exposed = area inside 0.25° cells with a robust increase (≥80% sign agreement and Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted Wilcoxon p < 0.05 across the cells of each map). Crop areas as in Table 6.", digits = 0)
# ---------------- v2.1 (audit M5): graded exposure (primary) ----------------
# Frequency-weighted exposure E = sum(rainfed area x drought frequency) = expected rainfed area in drought in an average month.
# Change relative to the baseline exposure E0 (each model's own 1985-2014 frequency). Classes: future frequency as a multiple of
# the cell's baseline frequency (<1, 1-1.25, 1.25-1.5, 1.5-2, >=2): breaks are defined relative to the baseline itself.
FB <- rbindlist(lapply(TOP, function(mdl) rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) { pr <- PROJ[[mdl]][[s]]
  data.table(model = mdl, scenario = s, cell = seq_len(ncol(pr$cell_sel)), fb = 100 * colMeans(pr$cell_sel[pr$years >= BASE[1] & pr$years <= BASE[2], ] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE)) }))))
FB <- FB[, .(fb = sum(WTS[model] * fb) / sum(WTS[model])), by = .(scenario, cell)]
CEG <- merge(CE[, .(scenario, period, cell, d_freq, robust, lon, lat)], FB, by = c("scenario", "cell"))
CEG[, `:=`(ff = pmax(fb + d_freq, 0), ratio = pmax(fb + d_freq, 0) / fb)]
CLS <- c("< 1 (decrease)", "1–1.25", "1.25–1.5", "1.5–2", "≥ 2")
CEG[, cls := cut(ratio, c(-Inf, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, Inf), labels = CLS, right = FALSE)]
xy01 <- xyFromCell(crop_ha, seq_len(ncell(crop_ha)))
pkey <- paste(round(floor(xy01[, 1] / 0.25) * 0.25 + 0.125, 3), round(floor(xy01[, 2] / 0.25) * 0.25 + 0.125, 3))
fw <- unique(EXPO[, .(district, f_w, f_g)]); did <- dlev[match(dvals, dlev[, 1]), 2]
PIX <- data.table(ck = pkey, district = did, wheat = values(whe)[, 1] * fw$f_w[match(did, fw$district)], gnut = values(gro)[, 1] * fw$f_g[match(did, fw$district)])[!is.na(district)]
PIX <- PIX[, .(wheat = sum(wheat, na.rm = TRUE), gnut = sum(gnut, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(ck, district)]
EXG <- rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) rbindlist(lapply(c("near", "mid", "far"), function(p) {
  g <- CEG[scenario == s & period == p][, ck := paste(round(lon, 3), round(lat, 3))]
  m <- merge(PIX, g[, .(ck, fb, ff, cls)], by = "ck")
  m[, .(E0_wheat = sum(wheat * fb / 100), E1_wheat = sum(wheat * ff / 100), E0_gnut = sum(gnut * fb / 100), E1_gnut = sum(gnut * ff / 100),
        wheat_total = sum(wheat), gnut_total = sum(gnut), wheat_ge15 = sum(wheat[cls %in% c("1.5–2", "≥ 2")]), wheat_ge2 = sum(wheat[cls == "≥ 2"]),
        gnut_ge15 = sum(gnut[cls %in% c("1.5–2", "≥ 2")])), by = district][, `:=`(scenario = s, period = p)] }))))
EXG <- rbind(EXG, EXG[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(scenario, period), .SDcols = E0_wheat:gnut_ge15][, district := "Potohar (all units)"], fill = TRUE)
EXG[, `:=`(dE_wheat_pct = 100 * (E1_wheat / E0_wheat - 1), dE_gnut_pct = 100 * (E1_gnut / E0_gnut - 1),
           share_wheat_ge15 = 100 * wheat_ge15 / wheat_total, share_wheat_ge2 = 100 * wheat_ge2 / wheat_total)]
# v3.1: uncertainty of the graded wheat exposure change. Each GCM's own cell frequencies give a per-model change; reported as the
# skill-weighted mean, the weighted 10th-90th percentile model range, a model-level bootstrap 95% CI (NB resamples of the GCMs)
# and the weighted share of models with an increase.
EXM <- rbindlist(lapply(TOP, function(mdl) rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) { pr <- PROJ[[mdl]][[s]]
  fbm <- 100 * colMeans(pr$cell_sel[pr$years >= BASE[1] & pr$years <= BASE[2], ] <= THR, na.rm = TRUE)
  rbindlist(lapply(c("near", "mid", "far"), function(p) { d <- CELLCHG_ALL[model == mdl & scenario == s & period == p]
    cc <- cbind(data.table(cell = d$cell, fb = fbm[d$cell], ff = pmax(fbm[d$cell] + d$d_freq, 0)), ANA[d$cell, .(lon, lat)])[, ck := paste(round(lon, 3), round(lat, 3))]
    m <- merge(PIX, cc[, .(ck, fb, ff)], by = "ck")
    rbind(m[, .(E0 = sum(wheat * fb), E1 = sum(wheat * ff)), by = district], m[, .(district = "Potohar (all units)", E0 = sum(wheat * fb), E1 = sum(wheat * ff))])[,
      `:=`(model = mdl, scenario = s, period = p)] })) }))))
EXM[, dE := 100 * (E1 / E0 - 1)]
wq <- function(x, w, p) { o <- order(x); cw <- cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w); x[o][which(cw >= p)[1]] }
set.seed(SEED)
EXU <- EXM[, { w <- WTS[model]; bt <- replicate(NB, { i <- sample(.N, replace = TRUE); sum(w[i] * dE[i]) / sum(w[i]) })
  .(dE_wmean = sum(w * dE) / sum(w), p10 = wq(dE, w, 0.10), p90 = wq(dE, w, 0.90), ci_lo = quantile(bt, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_hi = quantile(bt, 0.975, names = FALSE), agree_increase = sum(w[dE > 0]) / sum(w), n_models = .N) }, by = .(district, scenario, period)]
KEY$exposure_uncertainty <- EXU
fwrite(EXM, file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "exposure_graded_by_model.csv")); fwrite(EXU, file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "exposure_graded_uncertainty.csv"))
TS8 <- EXU[period %in% c("mid", "far"), .(District = district, Scenario = SCEN_LAB[scenario], Period = period, `Δ wheat exposure, weighted mean (%)` = dE_wmean,
            `Model range p10–p90 (%)` = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", p10, p90), `Bootstrap 95% CI (%)` = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", ci_lo, ci_hi),
            `Models with an increase (weighted %)` = 100 * agree_increase)][order(District == "Potohar (all units)", District, Scenario, Period)]
save_table(TS8, "S8", "Uncertainty of the change in frequency-weighted rainfed-wheat exposure", "TableS8_exposure_uncertainty",
           note = paste0("Per-GCM exposure change from each model's own cell drought frequencies (", SEL_NAME, " ≤ −1) and the same crop areas as Table 6; weights ∝ 1/L. ",
                         "Model range: weighted 10th–90th percentiles; CI: ", NB, " model-level bootstrap resamples. The Table 6 value pools the ensemble cell frequencies first, so it can differ slightly from the weighted mean of the per-model changes."), digits = 1)
EXCLS <- rbindlist(lapply(SCEN, function(s) rbindlist(lapply(c("near", "mid", "far"), function(p) {
  g <- CEG[scenario == s & period == p][, ck := paste(round(lon, 3), round(lat, 3))]
  merge(PIX, g[, .(ck, cls)], by = "ck")[, .(wheat = sum(wheat), gnut = sum(gnut)), by = cls][, `:=`(scenario = s, period = p)] }))))
KEY$exposure_graded <- EXG; KEY$exposure_classes <- EXCLS
fwrite(EXG, file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "exposure_graded_by_district.csv")); fwrite(EXCLS, file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "exposure_by_frequency_class.csv"))
T6 <- dcast(EXG[period %in% c("mid", "far")], district + round(wheat_total) + round(gnut_total) ~ scenario + period,
            value.var = c("dE_wheat_pct", "share_wheat_ge15", "dE_gnut_pct"), fun.aggregate = function(x) round(sum(x), 1))
setnames(T6, 2:3, c("Rainfed wheat (ha)", "Rainfed groundnut (ha)"))
T6 <- T6[order(district == "Potohar (all units)")]
save_table(T6, 6, paste0("Graded exposure of rainfed crops to ", SEL_NAME, " drought, by district: change in frequency-weighted exposure (%) and share of wheat area where drought frequency reaches ≥1.5× its baseline (%)"),
           "Table6_exposure_by_district",
           note = paste0("Frequency-weighted exposure = Σ rainfed area × drought frequency (", SEL_NAME, " ≤ −1), relative to the 1985–2014 baseline exposure; skill-weighted ensemble frequencies per 0.25° cell. ",
                         "Classes are multiples of each cell's baseline frequency. Crop areas: Crop Reporting Service Punjab un-irrigated area (mean 2021-22 to 2023-24), allocated within districts by SPAM2010 and WorldCover 2021. ",
                         "Binary hotspot exposure: Table S3."), digits = 1)
```

The SPAM2010 rainfed areas used above were checked against the irrigated / un-irrigated split reported by the Crop Reporting Service Punjab. Wheat comes from the *Final Rabi Estimates* books (2011-12, 2012-13 and 2016-17 to 2025-26) and groundnut from the *Final Kharif Estimates* books (2017-18 to 2025-26) (Table S2).

```{r rainfed-check}
sp <- rast(file.path(ROOT, "10_exposure", "spam2010_potohar.tif")); names(sp) <- c("WHEA_R", "WHEA_A", "GROU_R", "GROU_A")
ex <- as.data.table(terra::extract(sp, vect(dist), exact = TRUE))
SPD <- ex[, .(spam_wheat_rf = sum(WHEA_R * fraction, na.rm = TRUE), spam_wheat_all = sum(WHEA_A * fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
              spam_gnut_rf = sum(GROU_R * fraction, na.rm = TRUE), spam_gnut_all = sum(GROU_A * fraction, na.rm = TRUE)), by = ID]
SPD[, district := dist$district[ID]]
cw <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "yields", "district_wheat_irrigation_crs.csv"))
cg <- fread(file.path(ROOT, "data", "yields", "district_groundnut.csv"))
for (x in list(cw, cg)) x[, district := fifelse(district == "Islamabad", "Islamabad (ICT)", district)]
crs_sum <- function(x, yrs) x[harvest_year %in% yrs, .(rf_kha = mean(rainfed_area_000ha), share = sum(rainfed_area_000ha) / sum(area_000ha)), by = district]
S2 <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "district", all = TRUE), list(

  SPD[, .(district, `SPAM2010 groundnut rainfed (10³ ha)` = spam_gnut_rf / 1e3, `SPAM2010 groundnut rainfed share` = spam_gnut_rf / spam_gnut_all)],
  crs_sum(cg, 2018:2025)[, .(district, `CRS groundnut rainfed (10³ ha), 2017-25` = rf_kha, `CRS groundnut rainfed share, 2017-25` = share)]))
tot <- function(col) sum(S2[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
KEY$rainfed_share_by_district <- cw[harvest_year %in% 2017:2024, .(wheat_share = sum(rainfed_area_000ha) / sum(area_000ha)), by = district]

  gnut_share_crs = cg[harvest_year %in% 2018:2025, sum(rainfed_area_000ha) / sum(area_000ha)],
  gnut_rf_kha_crs = tot("CRS groundnut rainfed (10³ ha), 2017-25"), gnut_rf_kha_spam = tot("SPAM2010 groundnut rainfed (10³ ha)"),
  jhelum_wheat_share_crs = S2[district == "Jhelum", `CRS wheat rainfed share, 2016-24`])
save_table(S2, "S2", "Rainfed wheat and groundnut: SPAM2010 (used for exposure) vs Crop Reporting Service Punjab irrigated / un-irrigated statistics, by district",
           "TableS2_rainfed_check_CRS", note = "CRS: Final Rabi (wheat) and Final Kharif (groundnut) Estimates books, Crop Reporting Service, Agriculture Department Punjab; un-irrigated (barani) area. Shares are area-weighted over the seasons shown.", digits = 2)
